title: Frontend/Fullstack-utvecklare till produktbolag
description:
Vår kund arbetar är en snabbväxande aktör inom bilhandel där handlare köper och säljer fordon mellan varandra via deras plattform. Utöver marknadsplatsen erbjuder vi även: Logistik och internationell transport Finansiering Tester och garantier Bolaget grundades 2018 och finns idag i flera europeiska marknader, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. De drivs av ett entreprenöriellt team och har stark finansiell backing med fokus på skalbara och lönsamma bolag. Vi på kumpan har samarbetat med denna kund en längre tid och nu vill de rekrytera och vi på Kumpan hjälper de med det.
  
  

Om rollen Som Senior Fullstack Developer blir man en nyckelperson i bolagets techteam och arbetar brett med både frontend och backend. Rollen innebär stor möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arbetssätt och plattformens framtida utveckling. Ansvarsområden inkluderar: Utveckling och vidareutveckling av plattformen Deltagande i och drivande av code reviews Bidrag till och utveckling av tech stack Integration av nya system i samband med förvärv Utforskning och implementering av AI-lösningar Nära samarbete med produkt och affär Under de första månaderna förväntas kandidaten snabbt sätta sig in i plattformen, bidra till kodbasen och vara med och strukturera tekniska arbetssätt. Kvalifikationer Minst 6 års arbetserfarenhet av TypeScript, Node.js och React Erfarenhet av databaser (t.ex.
  
  

PostgreSQL) Stark förståelse för kodkvalitet och vana av code reviews Flytande svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Meriterande: Erfarenhet av AI-verktyg DevOps Plattformar eller marketplaces Fintech eller transaktionsintensiva system Persona Vår kund söker en självständig och ansvarstagande utvecklare som brinner för teknik och problemlösning. Du är nyfiken, tekniskt driven och trivs i en snabbrörlig miljö där du får testa ny teknik och bidra till utvecklingen av plattformen. De erbjuder dig möjligheten att påverka i det dagliga arbetet. Du arbetar nära både affär och ledning och får vara med och bygga något som kommer att ha stor påverkan inom området.
  
  

Du blir en del av ett entreprenöriellt team med snabba beslut och hög grad av autonomi, där ditt engagemang och din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad.

title: Product Developer Assistant
description:
**Established in 1986 in the Swedish mountains, our love for skiing in untouched terrain and embarking on adventures in the wild run deep. Our purpose is simple: to bring this freeride spirit to the world. With our products, we aim to make adventures possible 365 days a year.**

**We are driven by passion, togetherhood, responsibility and winning spirit. We know that an inspiring spread of unique abilities and personalities contribute to our dynamic culture and our success. Now, we are looking for a new talent to join our team.**


This is an opportunity for you who want to work in a cross-functional team with developing our high-quality products to our end consumer all over the world.


As a **Product Developer Assistant** you will have an important role in the exciting and yet complex process of creating our fantastic products. Together with a tight team you will work with the development and innovation of our different product lines, ensuring that each piece meets the brand’s high standards for quality, design, and sustainability.


Your main responsibility will be to work close with Product Developer and support in the daily work such as oversee the development process, source materials, ensure quality and fit, manage costing, maintain accurate product data, and foster effective communication with internal departments and external suppliers.


You will be working in a dynamic and global organization, where teamwork and passion are key factors for our success. The position is based at Peak Performance HQ in Stockholm where you will be part of our Product Development team and report to Product Development Manager.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Product Developer throughout the entire product development process within the assigned product categories.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Developers, Product Managers, Designers, Pattern Makers and Fabric Teams to ensure effective communication and alignment throughout the development process.
* Drive and coordinate assigned product development activities across functions to support timelines, deliverables and seasonal milestones.
* Own and maintain product development data, documentation and relevant systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency and timely updates throughout the development process.
* Monitor and proactively follow up on sample status, development activities and key actions to support an efficient product development process.
* Participate actively in fittings, collection meetings and other relevant product development forums.
* Together with the Product Developer, ensure complete and accurate product information and instructions are communicated to the production office and suppliers in a timely manner.
* Act as a key coordination point between internal stakeholders, production offices and suppliers, supporting a smooth and efficient development process.
* Contribute to ensuring that products meet Peak Performance's premium quality standards in accordance with the Quality Assurance Manual (QAM) and support the achievement of our sustainability goals.

**Who we think you are:**

* You have a genuine interest in products, materials and product development.
* You are curious and eager to learn and develop within the field.
* You enjoy being close to the product and involved throughout the development journey.
* You are motivated by the opportunity to grow your knowledge and gradually take on more responsibility.
* You are excited about being part of creating great products for consumers around the world.

**Job Requirements:**

* Minimum one year of experience in product development, textiles, buying or a related field.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and functions.
* A proactive approach with the confidence to take initiative and move tasks forward.
* A hands-on and unpretentious approach, combined with a flexible attitude.
* Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* A results-oriented mindset with good commercial awareness.

**What we offer:**


We offer you an inspiring work environment where our values of Passion, Togetherhood, Responsibility and Winning Spirit are at the core of everything we do, promoting creativity, teamwork, accountability, and progress. You get the opportunity to work with a great team that shares your passion for sports and outdoor life. We are on a growth journey, finding our line and building our future success. That provides interesting challenges and possibilities in all roles for the person who is curious and likes to get things done. We’re small enough for you to play a key role regardless of your position, but big enough to have a global presence. At Peak Performance, you get the best of both worlds.

  

To live our brand, we also offer:

* Workout classes and yoga classes in our Training Box at HQ
* Sports Hour – 1 hour training on Fridays (activity of your own choice)
* Mountain house & Apartment in Åre. Available for rent and team activities.
* Health care allowance – 3000 SEK per year
* Pension advisory via Linder & Partners
* Skandia Health Insurance


If our values inspire you and you share our passion for outdoor sports and products that combines style and performance, we want you to join our winning team. Apply now and unlock your freeride spirit!

title: Mjukvaruutvecklare / Junior Produktägare inom Försvarsindustrin
description:
Vill du fortsätta utveckla mjukvara, men samtidigt börja ta ett större ansvar för hur teamet planerar, prioriterar och tar sig framåt? Här får du kombinera hands-on utveckling med möjligheten att växa in i ett mer tekniskt ledande ansvar. Du blir en del av ett team inom försvarsindustrin som utvecklar mjukvara och testsystem för avancerad elektronik. Mjukvaran används för att testa och verifiera att elektroniska produkter fungerar som de ska – vilket innebär ett nära samarbete mellan mjukvara, hårdvara och andra tekniska kompetenser.
  
  

**Om tjänsten:** Rollen passar dig som har arbetat några år som utvecklare och vill ta nästa steg utan att släppa programmeringen. Ungefär halva tiden arbetar du hands-on med utveckling och resterande tid får du vara med och skapa struktur, planera arbetet och hjälpa teamet att prioritera rätt. Du behöver inte ha haft titeln Product Owner tidigare. Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på att ta mer ansvar, gillar att samarbeta och vill vara med och påverka både tekniken och teamets arbetssätt.
  
  

På sikt finns möjlighet att utvecklas vidare inom exempelvis produktledning, systemledning eller andra tekniska ledarroller. Arbetsuppgifter: Utveckla och underhålla mjukvara i C, C++ och Java Arbeta med testmjukvara och testsystem för elektronik och hårdvara Felsöka, analysera och förbättra tekniska lösningar Planera, prioritera och bryta ner teamets arbete tillsammans med kollegor Samarbeta nära utvecklare, testare och andra tekniska specialister Bidra till tekniska vägval och förbättrade arbetssätt Vi söker dig som: Har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, mjukvaruutveckling eller elektroteknik Har några års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling Har programmerat i C, C++ och/eller Java Har arbetat nära hårdvara, elektronik, embedded-system eller tekniska testsystem Är intresserad av att kombinera utveckling med ett större ansvar för struktur, planering och tekniska prioriteringar Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska Om anställningen: Detta är ett konsultuppdrag som innebär att du kommer vara anställd hos Friday. Denna tjänst omfattas av säkerhetsskydd. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.
  
  

För vissa roller kan krav på svenskt medborgarskap förekomma. Övrig info: Omfattning: Heltid Start: Omgående Placering: Norrort, Stockholm Lön: Marknadsmässig Rekryteringsansvarig: Axel Stubbing Om Friday: På Friday hjälper vi Tech-talanger att hitta roller där de trivs, utvecklas och gör skillnad. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
  
  

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Junior Power BI and Fabric Developer
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Junior Power BI and Fabric Developer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve.


The partner is strengthening its capability in self-service reporting built on governed data products. You will take responsibility for work that connects Power BI, DAX and Microsoft Fabric, while ensuring that SQL and data visualisation receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design.

### **How you will work**


You will work with engineers, analysts and domain specialists who look at the same information from different angles. The partner expects assumptions, datasets and evaluation methods to be visible. Solutions should be designed for repeatable delivery, monitored use and responsible change after deployment.


This role calls for strong foundations, curiosity and the discipline to learn quickly. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for self-service reporting built on governed data products.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for Power BI and DAX.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around Microsoft Fabric.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting SQL.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve data visualisation.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering self-service reporting built on governed data products in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Power BI and DAX.
* Practical experience applying Microsoft Fabric and SQL.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving data visualisation.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from finance, sales or operational analytics teams.
* Exposure to stakeholder discovery in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of self-service reporting built on governed data products is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on self-service reporting built on governed data products gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

title: Senior C++ Systems Developer - Live Media
description:
**OFFER**

  

When live video travels across networks, every part of the system needs to deliver. At Net Insight, you will work on the software that makes reliable media transport possible — solving demanding engineering problems together with experienced colleagues who enjoy sharing their knowledge.


We are looking for a senior C++ developer to join the Nimbra Edge team. This is a hands-on role with substantial technical ownership, where you will improve performance, investigate complex problems and influence the architecture behind a product used in professional media delivery.


Some of the reasons to join Net Insight:

* Technically challenging work in modern C++23, close to Linux, networking and hardware.
* The opportunity to influence architecture, implementation and development practices.
* A small, autonomous team within an established international technology company.
* Friendly, knowledgeable colleagues who value collaboration and open discussion.
* Flexible working hours and a workplace that understands life outside work.

 **THE PRODUCT AND TEAM**

  

Nimbra Edge enables the transport of live video across internet and private networks. You will join the team responsible for its dataplane: the C++ software that handles the actual flow of media through the system.


The dataplane team consists of four engineers and works closely with seven colleagues developing the cloud parts of the product. Together, they cover a broad technical scope, from cloud software to the systems interacting with the underlying hardware.


It is a friendly, collaborative group where you can discuss a difficult problem, challenge an idea and ask for another perspective. You will have room to work independently, with colleagues who support one another and care about the quality of the result.

 **THE ROLE**

  

A central part of your work will be getting more from the available hardware: increasing channel capacity, reducing resource consumption and maintaining predictable performance under demanding conditions.


You will move between architectural decisions and detailed investigation, following a problem through the stack to understand its root cause. That might mean examining memory access and concurrency, analysing network traffic or investigating how Linux scheduling affects latency.


Your work will include:

* Developing and improving performance-critical software in modern C++.
* Profiling and optimising CPU, memory and network resource usage.
* Investigating difficult bugs across software, operating system and hardware interactions.
* Making architectural decisions and building solutions that remain clear and maintainable.
* Reviewing code and sharing technical knowledge within the team.
* Testing and validating behaviour on real hardware in the lab.


The current focus includes high-performance packet processing with DPDK and uncompressed video and audio transport using SMPTE ST 2110. You will also encounter precision timing, Linux tuning and hardware-accelerated media processing.

**You can learn ST 2110 and DPDK here.** What you bring is the systems knowledge and engineering judgement needed to understand challenging problems and work through them.

**YOUR PROFILE**

  

You are an experienced developer who still enjoys being deeply involved in the code. You take initiative when the next step is unclear, investigate before drawing conclusions and look for solutions that keep the system as simple as possible.


You also enjoy working with others. You explain your reasoning, listen to different perspectives and share what you learn. Your technical contribution includes helping the team reach sound decisions together.


We are looking for:

* 10+ years of professional software development experience.
* Deep knowledge of modern C++ and systems programming, including memory management, concurrency and performance profiling.
* Strong Linux experience, including troubleshooting involving the operating system, scheduling or hardware.
* Solid networking fundamentals and confidence analysing traffic and protocol behaviour at packet level.
* Experience developing performance-critical or real-time software with demanding latency, jitter or throughput requirements.
* The ability to take ownership of technical problems and make well-founded design decisions.


Experience with video streaming protocols and media transport is particularly valuable. Other relevant experience includes DPDK or XDP, precision time synchronisation, NICs and drivers, or hardware-accelerated media processing.


Your background may be in media technology, telecom, networking or another field with demanding systems and performance requirements. Previous broadcast experience is welcome, but is not required.


The team also uses AI tools in its development workflow, and welcomes curiosity about how they can support your work.

**LOCATION**  

Net Insight develops technology for professional media networks, helping broadcasters, service providers and media organisations transport live content reliably. Its engineering work spans hardware, networking and cloud software, bringing together specialists across several technical disciplines.


For more info, visit https://netinsight.net/

**This recruitment is direct employment at Net Insight AB and all applications, questions, administration, and recruitment processes are managed by Pinetree AB.**

title: Web Developer Frontend – Marketing (m/f/d) | Legal AI Tech Scale-Up | Hybrid
description:
#### **Your team**


At **Noxtua**, we’re building Europe’s Legal AI, and our marketing team’s mission is to make Noxtua the name legal professionals across Europe know and trust. You’ll join a growing marketing team of eight people and help make our website the place where that trust starts. You’ll collaborate across Brand, Product Marketing, PR, Product, and GTM, working most closely with our Web Content Manager, Brand Marketing Lead, Product Marketing Manager, and PR specialists.  

  

You’ll report to **Rafael Arcoverde**, Brand Marketing Lead at Noxtua, who has spent the last 19 years in marketing, working on projects for clients including Warner Bros., Hornbach, McDonald’s, Sheraton, Red Bull, Unilever, and Bunge. His background is in Social Communications and Advertising, and he holds an MBA with a specialisation in Marketing. He has worked in hyper-growth tech startups and with global teams.  

  

Our websites are often the first place a lawyer, general counsel, or partner meets Noxtua. They need to be fast, accessible, secure, and visibly premium. As our Frontend Web Developer, you’ll own how the Noxtua website and our sub-brand sites are built and how they perform. You’ll work closely with our Web Content Manager and the wider Brand Marketing team, turning brand and campaign ideas into polished, high-converting web experiences.

#### **About you**

* You have **3+ years of experience** building and maintaining websites, ideally marketing or corporate websites in B2B SaaS.
* Strong **frontend skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript.** You build responsive, pixel-accurate pages from Figma designs.
* Hands-on experience with a modern **CMS (e.g., Webflow, WordPress, or a headless CMS such as Contentful, Storyblok, or Sanity)**, including building reusable templates and components.
* You know how to make a site fast **(Core Web Vitals)** and technically sound for search (structured data, metadata, sitemaps, redirects).
* You've set up **analytics and tags (****Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager)** and connected forms to marketing tools **(e.g. HubSpot)**, with consent management in mind.
* **Strong ability** to work well with marketers and designers, explain technical trade-offs simply, and make the site easy for others to update.
* Languages: Fluent **English. German** is a plus.

#### **Your responsibilities**

* **Build the website:** develop pages, landing pages, and campaign pages from Figma designs, fast and on-brand.
* **Own the foundations:** build and maintain reusable templates and components so the marketing team can create pages without a developer.
* **Keep it fast and findable:** own site performance, accessibility and technical SEO.
* **Connect the stack:** set up and maintain forms, tracking, consent and integrations with our marketing and sales tools.
* **Improve conversion:** run tests on pages, forms and calls to action together with Marketing.
* **Support our growth across Europe:** build and maintain multilingual versions of the site, keeping security and data protection in mind.

#### **Our offer to you**


Building Europe's sovereign Legal AI is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.

* **Contract:** Permanent, full-time employment (tillsvidareanställning)
* **Working model:** Hybrid — a mix of office and remote work, with flexible working hours
* **Vacation:** 26 vacation days and 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
* **Pension & insurance**: Occupational pension and insurance package
* **Health:** Private health insurance
* **Wellness allowance** (friskvårdsbidrag): SEK 5,000 per year, reimbursable against invoices
* **Equipment:** Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus a SEK 11,000 net home office setup budget

#### **About us**


Noxtua (noxtua.com) is Europe's Legal AI built for legal professionals in law firms, legal departments, public administration, and the judiciary. Its AI covers the full workflow of legal text work: research, analysis of complex legal issues, and document drafting. Noxtua is built to meet the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements specific to the legal profession — including Section 203 of the German Criminal Code and Section 43e of the Federal Code for Lawyers — and holds certifications including BSI C5, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001. In partnership with leading European legal publishers, Noxtua is also building Europe's largest legal database, with more than 130 million searchable documents, and offering the market's first cross-continental European license.  

  

Founded in 2017 in Berlin on research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the company has offices in Paris, Berlin, Stockholm, Zagreb, Munich and Fribourg. Strategic investors include C.H.BECK, and MANZ, who have committed around €100 million as part of a Series C round in 2026.  

  

**We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.**

title: BI Developer in Solution Team ﻿
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*

### 
**Your Role**

Join our Analytics & Data Solutions team and help transform data into insights, decisions, and intelligent solutions. You will work across the full analytics lifecycle, from data ingestion and engineering to modeling, visualization, and emerging AI-driven capabilities. As our analytics landscape evolves from Qlik to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, you will have a key role in designing scalable data products and enabling data-driven decision-making across the business.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


* Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into data, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Create dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics experiences using Qlik Sense and Power BI.
* Design, build, and maintain data products using Microsoft Fabric, including lakehouses, data pipelines, semantic models, and analytics solutions.
* Explore and implement new capabilities within Microsoft Fabric, including automation, AI-powered analytics, copilots, and intelligent agents.
* Ensure high standards for data quality, governance, documentation, and lifecycle management.
* Work with data modeling, semantic layers, and business definitions to create consistent and reusable analytical assets.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, analysts, and domain experts to deliver end-to-end analytics solutions.
* Contribute to the continuous development of our analytics platform, standards, and ways of working.
  

  

The position can be based in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Karlstad, Malmö, Linköping or Karlskoga.

  

  

### **Your profile**


We're looking for a curious and forward-thinking analytics professional who enjoys solving business problems with data and technology. You are comfortable working across both traditional BI development and modern cloud-based analytics platforms, and you are excited by the opportunities created by AI and data innovation.

  

  

**We believe you have**


* More than 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a similar field.
* Experience developing analytics solutions in Qlik Sense.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including one or more of Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, Semantic Models, or Power BI.
* Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and data transformation processes.
* Experience with Power BI and modern self-service analytics.
* Knowledge of data warehousing, data lakes, and modern cloud data platforms.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and analytics best practices.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to bridge business and technology.
  

  

**Nice to Have**


* Experience with Python, Spark, or similar technologies is considered a merit.
* Experience with AI-powered analytics.
* Experience working with data products, semantic models, or domain-oriented analytics.
* Experience from large and complex organizations.

Experience working within a regulated or security-sensitive environment.  
* 

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*

  

### 
**What you will be part of**

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

  

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

  

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Business Developer
description:
Be part of turning strategy into action at the heart of the CIO Office. In this position, you combine business development and transformation with the opportunity to influence how IT works, collaborates, and delivers value across the organization.

### **What’s in it for you?**

* A highly varied position with opportunities to contribute across multiple strategic initiatives and improvement areas.
* Build a broad network and collaborate with colleagues across IT and the business.
* Shape new ways of working while developing your own responsibilities and areas of impact over time.

### **About the job**


You help the CIO Office translate strategic priorities, transformation initiatives, and improvement opportunities into structured execution and measurable outcomes. Your main focus is business development, while you also ensure stable governance and continuous improvement within IT Asset & Configuration Management.

### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive and support business development and transformation initiatives from definition and planning through execution and follow-up.
* Help execute strategy, improve ways of working, and create transparency across priorities and initiatives.
* Facilitate workshops, innovation days, and other cross-functional improvement activities.
* Create clear communication and follow-up around progress, decisions, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across IT and the business to move initiatives forward.
* Own and continuously improve IT Asset & Configuration Management, including governance, CMDB, data quality, and lifecycle management.

### **Location**


This position is based on-site in Sandviken or Stockholm.

### **Your profile**


With a practical mindset and a strong understanding of how people, processes, and business priorities connect, you turn complex challenges into clear and actionable plans. You’re comfortable coordinating several initiatives and driving progress through collaboration rather than formal authority.

### **Your background includes**

* A university degree or equivalent experience, preferably within IT, business, engineering, industrial management, or another relevant field.
* Experience in business development, transformation, project or initiative management, process improvement, IT, or a comparable area.
* Proven ability to create structure, prioritize effectively and move multiple initiatives forward.
* Experience working cross-functionally with stakeholders across different parts of an organization.
* Strong written and spoken English.

  

Experience with IT Asset Management, Configuration Management, CMDB, ServiceNow, or CSDM is beneficial. Knowledge of portfolio management, strategy execution, product-led transformation, facilitation or innovation initiatives is also an advantage, as is an interest in AI, automation, and modern digital ways of working.

  

You’re proactive and solution-oriented, creating clarity when priorities change or situations are ambiguous. Strong communication and relationship-building skills help you influence, coordinate, and bring people together, while your collaborative approach supports continuous improvement and enables others to succeed.

### **The team**


You join the Business Support team within the CIO Office. The team works closely across IT and the business, supporting transformation, business development, strategy execution, and continuous improvement through frequent collaboration with different functions and business areas.

### **Our culture**


Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. title: Microsoft Fabric and Power Platform Developer
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Microsoft Fabric and Power Platform Developer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve.


The partner is strengthening its capability in governed low-code solutions connected to modern analytics. You will take responsibility for work that connects Microsoft Fabric, Power Apps and Power Automate, while ensuring that Dataverse and Power BI receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design.

### **How you will work**


The work combines planned platform development with investigation of real production behaviour. You will collaborate with application teams, security and operations, using their feedback to decide what should become a shared service, an automated control or clear documentation. Ownership continues after the first release.


This role calls for solid delivery experience and the appetite to take broader ownership. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for governed low-code solutions connected to modern analytics.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for Microsoft Fabric and Power Apps.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around Power Automate.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting Dataverse.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve Power BI.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering governed low-code solutions connected to modern analytics in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Power Apps.
* Practical experience applying Power Automate and Dataverse.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving Power BI.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from operations, finance or customer-service organisations.
* Exposure to governance in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of governed low-code solutions connected to modern analytics is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on governed low-code solutions connected to modern analytics gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

title: Embedded Developer till innovativt teknikbolag
description:

Rollen kombinerar embeddedutveckling i C/C++ med kretskortsdesign, främst i KiCad. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från idé och konstruktion till test och färdig produkt. Arbetet omfattar bland annat BMS, styrenheter och VCU. Du får stort eget ansvar och förväntas självständigt driva dina uppgifter framåt.

Företaget präglas av korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och möjligheten att påverka såväl tekniska lösningar som arbetssätt. * bygga backendtjänster och REST-API:er i Java och Spring Boot,
* bygga användargränssnitt och e-tjänster i Angular,

Robert Modén, enhetschef

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss behöver du stå för och leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden och till våra kärnvärden för medarbetarskap: förebild, tillit, ansvar, samarbete och utveckling. Läs mer på www.skolverket.se/jobb

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
*Här får du arbeta med långsiktig produktutveckling tillsammans med kompetenta och seniora kollegor. Vi lägger stort fokus på din utveckling och du får en skräddarsydd utvecklingsplan som passar dig och dina personliga mål. Vi arbetar dessutom utifrån en hybrid arbetsmodell där det finns stort utrymme för flexibilitet. Välkommen till oss på CAB!*

**Om tjänsten**
---------------


Nu erbjuder vi en utvecklande roll som Senior Software Developer för vår produkt MEPS. I MEPS samarbetar fastighetsbolag, försäkringsbolag och entreprenörer kring uppdrag som rör ROT och reparation i fastigheter, på ett effektivt, transparent och lönsamt sätt. I den här rollen får du möjlighet att arbeta ur ett helhetsperspektiv med att driva förbättringar av allt från mjukvarudesign, implementation, integration till driftsättning av kod.

**Att vara utvecklare på CAB**
------------------------------


På CAB arbetar vi enligt DevOps och CI/CD eftersom vi tycker att det är viktigt att våra utvecklingsteam får följa resultatet av de produkter de arbetar med, över tid. Som utvecklare är du alltså delaktig i hela utvecklingskedjan, från kravställning och design till färdig produkt. Varje team består av utvecklare som jobbar både backend och frontend, scrum master, lead developer och testare.


Dessutom är vi väldigt förtjusta i att arbeta med teknik i framkant och har en Microsoftbaserad utvecklingsmiljö där vi bland annat använder:

* .NET, C#, och SQL
* Webbramverket Angular.
* Github Copilot
* Azure är vår primära driftmiljö där vi strävar mot mikrotjänstarkitektur, containers, eventbaserade lösningar och infrastruktur som kod.


I dagsläget är vi mer än 100 medarbetare som arbetar inhouse i våra utvecklingsteam på kontoren i Örebro, Göteborg och Oslo.


**När du utvecklas, utvecklas vi!**
-----------------------------------


Självklart är det även viktigt att du får tid att utvecklas och ta dig an ny kunskap, därför lägger vi stort fokus på din kompetensutveckling. Vi tror det mesta kommer ske i det dagliga arbetet där du omges av kompetenta och ambitiösa kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap och som vill lära sig av dig.


Detta sker genom bland annat:

* Regelbundna Lab Days där du helt fritt kan välja tekniker, plattformar eller metoder att fördjupa dig inom.
* Kompetensutveckling via utvecklarkonferenser eller liknande forum.
* CAB Tech Talk - en seminarieserie där du som utvecklare har möjlighet att dela kunskap, den senaste tekniken eller utvecklingslösningar med dina kollegor.


Detta i kombination med en bred produktportfölj skapar förutsättningar för många utvecklingsmöjligheter.

**Klicka här och läs mer om vårt förmånspaket och hur vi strävar efter att alltid vara en riktigt bra arbetsplats!**

**Är du den vi söker?**
-----------------------


Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare och har flera års arbetslivserfarenhet inom .NET, C# samt SQL och webb. Du har också erfarenhet av lösningsdesign, utveckling av molnbaserade system och mikrotjänster. Vi tror att du är nyfiken och gärna tar initiativ till att skapa smarta tekniska lösningar och förbättra metoder genom hela processen, från krav till drift.


Vi använder AI i vårt dagliga arbete, bland annat genom Github Copilot och ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att jobba med AI.


För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du tycker om att ta dig an ny teknik och utvecklas tillsammans med andra. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du är nyfiken på andras perspektiv och idéer. Du en aktiv roll i teamets utveckling genom att bidra med teknisk vägledning, dela erfarenheter och stötta andra i deras utveckling. Du är kommunikativ, tycker om att samarbeta och ser kunskapsutbyte som en naturlig del av arbetet. Eftersom du arbetar genom hela livscykeln för de produkter du är med och utvecklar är helhetsperspektiv och ansvarstagande en självklar del av ditt arbetssätt.

**Låter det som något för dig? Tveka inte att söka redan idag!**

*På CAB vill vi ta tillvara de kvalitéer som mångfald tillför verksamheten. Därför arbetar vi med kompetensbaserad rekrytering för att säkerställa att alla kandidater bedöms på samma premisser och att vi alltid anställer de mest kvalificerade medarbetarna. Drivkraft, attityd, engagemang och ansvar är centrala delar i bedömningen- inte bara kunskap och tekniska färdigheter. Detta innebär att vi inte bara mäter vad kandidaten kan, utan även motivation och inställning. Med det sagt så välkomnar vi en bredd av sökande till våra tjänster- och ser fram emot att höra från dig!*


Urval sker löpande men annonsen är öppen till 6/11.


Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Julia Lindmark, tfn 070-615 84 06 eller julia.lindmark@cab.se.


I alla våra rekryteringar genomför vi bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat.

title: Salesforce Platform Developer
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Salesforce Platform Developer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve.


The partner is strengthening its capability in maintainable Salesforce solutions for complex customer processes. You will take responsibility for work that connects Apex, Lightning Web Components and Flow, while ensuring that integrations and automated testing receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design.

### **How you will work**


You will work across teams with different incentives, technical histories and decision rights. The partner expects concise preparation, visible dependencies and follow through after meetings. Strong performance means that people understand what was decided, why it matters and what they now own.


This role calls for solid delivery experience and the appetite to take broader ownership. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for maintainable Salesforce solutions for complex customer processes.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for Apex and Lightning Web Components.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around Flow.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting integrations.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve automated testing.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering maintainable Salesforce solutions for complex customer processes in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Apex and Lightning Web Components.
* Practical experience applying Flow and integrations.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving automated testing.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from B2B sales, service or partner ecosystems.
* Exposure to DevOps in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of maintainable Salesforce solutions for complex customer processes is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on maintainable Salesforce solutions for complex customer processes gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

title: Ignition Developer till TechSeed
description:
*På TechSeed är vi övertygade om att det är tekniken som kommer göra världen till en bättre plats. Vi ser ett stort behov i vårt samhälle att kombinera affärsförståelse, digitalt ledarskap samt innovativa arbetssätt och lösningar med framtidens tekniker i uppkopplade ekosystem. Vi tror på en hållbar framtid med säkra lösningar genom exempelvis IoT-lösningar, digitala tvillingar, AI och cybersäkerhet. Det här är vårt WHY och det fyller oss med energi varje dag. Det här är vår arena.*


TechSeed är ett medarbetarägt bolag som erbjuder konsulttjänster och har ett kompetensdjup inom flera domäner. Vi är på en kraftig tillväxtresa och söker nu en Ignition Developer som får stort inflytande och insyn i hur vi växer framåt och tar ett helhetsgrepp om uppkopplade ekosystem och lösningar. Vi söker dig som trivs i konsultrollen och samtidigt vill bidra till att skapa vägen framåt för TechSeed – Tillsammans.


Verktygen för att koppla upp industrin blir fler och vi har ett flertal partnerskap för de främsta plattformarna på marknaden, däribland Ignition. Hos våra kunder arbetar du med dessa plattformar för att implementera och förbättra IoT-lösningar, och du blir en viktig del i vår satsning på industriella smarta lösningar, ett område i TechSeeds absoluta kärna.


Du tillhör enheten Edge & IoT, en nyckelpartner för våra kunders IIoT/IoT-resa. Med kompetens inom utveckling, IoT-arkitektur, leverans och affärsrådgivning hjälper vi kunderna att konfigurera, utveckla och skräddarsy lösningar som passar deras behov.

**Vem söker vi?**


Vi söker dig som är driven, har lätt att knyta kontakter och snabbt förstår utmaningar du ställs inför. Du trivs i konsultrollen och går igång på att bidra, ta ägandeskap och bygga långsiktiga relationer.


Du har även:

* Mycket goda kunskaper inom **utveckling i Ignition** och de relevanta kompetenser som krävs för det
* Erfarenhet från industriell produktion och lösningar som **MES/SCADA**
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift


Om du är intresserad finns även möjligheten att lära dig våra andra system som Insights Hub, Industrial Edge och Building X.

title: Inhämtare/utvecklare vid Must till enheten för Teknisk Inhämtning
description:
**Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?**  

Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) söker nu en inhämtare/utvecklare till säkerhetsunderrättelseavdelningen. Du kommer arbeta inom området offensiv cyber och ha arbetsuppgifter med att utveckla egen mjukvara för insamling av information i vårt underrättelse- och utredningsverksamhet.



Ett viktigt inslag i arbetsuppgifterna är omvärldsbevakning och kompetensutveckling inom eget verksamhetsområde och du kommer att ha stora möjligheter att påverka enhetens metodutveckling och du har själv möjlighet att styra över din tekniska arbetsmiljö.



Du ska ha intresse för att utveckla egna tekniska lösningar för att upprätta god opsec och anonymitet för inhämtning inom cyberområdet.


**Om enheten**  

Säkerhetsunderrättelseavdelningen arbetar med att indikera, klarlägga och motverka säkerhetshotande verksamhet samt bedriva försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet kopplat till säkerhetshotande aktörer. Sektionen för teknisk inhämtning ansvarar för teknisk områdesexpertis vid säkerhetsunderrättelseoperationer- och utredningar.


**Personliga egenskaper**
  

Vi sätter stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och du som person ska vara företagsam och innovativ. Du arbetar självgående och driver ditt arbete framåt samt arbetar väl tillsammans i grupp mot gemensamma mål. Du är strukturerad, analytisk och resultatinriktad. Du drivs av att förstå hur saker hänger ihop och att lösa komplexa problem. Du har en hög personlig mognad, pålitlighet och integritet med hänsyn till arbetets natur.



Tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och mycket stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
* Erfarenhet av offensiv cyberverksamhet
* Erfarenhet av teknisk säkerhetsgranskning och sårbarhetsanalys
* Förståelse för säkerhetsmekanismer i moderna operativsystem och tekniker för att komma runt dessa
* B-körkort


Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.

description:
Vi söker en **Junior Fullstackutvecklare med inriktning mot .NET och Azure** till en kund inom **industriell tillverkning och robotteknik**.

Teamet utvecklar mjukvaruverktyg och produkter som stödjer tillverkningsverksamheten samt verktyg för organisationens forskning och utveckling (R&D).

**Om rollen**

Arbetet bedrivs i en SCRUM-baserad miljö med nära samarbete med intressenter och andra utvecklingsteam inom organisationen.

Teamet består av cirka 22 medarbetare, däribland utvecklare, lead developers, tekniska projektledare, mjukvaruarkitekter och systemtestare.

Rollen omfattar hela produktlivscykeln, från design och implementation till testning och verifiering. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar utveckling av nya produkter, underhåll av befintliga lösningar och kontinuerliga förbättringar av mjukvara för att möta verksamhetens föränderliga behov.

Vi söker en lagspelare som trivs i en miljö där samarbete och flexibilitet är avgörande för framgång.

Rollen erbjuder möjligheter att ta initiativ, driva utvecklingen framåt och bidra med teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet. Den utvalda kandidaten kommer att spela en viktig roll i att stödja och förbättra verksamhetens processer.

**Krav:**

* Kandidat- eller masterexamen inom teknik, gärna i kombination med några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling med .NET.

* Erfarenhet av backendutveckling med .NET-tekniker, exempelvis ASP.NET Core och Blazor.

title: BI/ETL-utvecklare
description:
**Om jobbet**
-------------


Som erfaren BI-utvecklare utvecklar och förvaltar du dataflöden från källsystem till datalager och vidare till rapportering och analys. Du arbetar med hela kedjan och behöver förstå sambanden mellan datakällor, ETL/ELT-flöden, datamodeller och rapporter.


Du designar och utvecklar olika nivåer av dataflöden, från enkla till komplexa och integrerar data från exempelvis databaser, API:er, filer och andra system. Arbetet innebär även att analysera, bygga om och effektivisera befintliga lösningar. Med stöd från verksamhet och i våra ETL-verktyg arbetar du med datamodellering samt hanterar inkrementella laddningar, fulladdningar, historik och förändringar i källdata.


I rollen kommer du och teamet bland annat att:


* säkerställa datakvalitet, prestanda och stabila lösningar för stora datamängder
* felsöka dataflöden och identifiera orsaker till felaktiga eller saknade data
* Utveckla nya, livscykelhantera och supportera dataflöden.
* automatisera och schemalägga dataflöden samt arbeta med versionshantering och CI/CD
* dokumentera lösningar och tekniska beslut så att de kan förstås och förvaltas av andra
* ta tekniskt ansvar och stödja mindre erfarna utvecklare genom kunskapsdelning och mentorskap.

Du arbetar nära andra BI-utvecklare, data engineers och analytiker. Tillsammans med teamet och verksamheten identifierar, prioriterar och planerar ni behov och omsätter dem i hållbara tekniska lösningar med stöd av agilt arbetssätt.


**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------


Vi söker dig som har:


* högskoleutbildning inom systemutveckling, datavetenskap eller ett annat relevant område. Alternativt har du annan utbildning i kombination med relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig
* flera års arbetslivserfarenhet som ETL-utvecklare, BI-utvecklare eller i en annan likvärdig roll
* erfarenhet av att utveckla och förvalta ETL/ELT-flöden
* erfarenhet av datamodellering för datalager, exempelvis enligt Data Vault, Kimball eller motsvarande metodik
* goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att arbeta med relationsdatabaser
* god förmåga att utrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har:


* praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla och förvalta ETL-flöden med WhereScape och/eller SSIS eller annat likvärdigt verktyg för ETL-flöden.
* Erfarenhet av containerteknik (exempelvis Red Hat OpenShift och/eller Kubernetes)
* erfarenhet av versionshantering och CI/CD
* erfarenhet av att ta tekniskt ansvar och leda mindre erfarna utvecklare.

Som person är du analytisk och lösningsorienterad. Du arbetar strukturerat och kan se både detaljerna och helheten i komplexa dataflöden. Eftersom rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med såväl tekniska specialister som verksamheten behöver du kommunicera tydligt och samarbeta väl. Du delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper och har ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt.


**Övrig information**
---------------------


Placeringsort för den här tjänsten är Borlänge eller Göteborg. Vill du ha en flexibel vardag med möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån? I den här rollen kan du jobba på distans upp till två dagar i veckan.


**Ansökan**
-----------


De frågor som du får besvara när du skickar in din ansökan kommer att ligga till grund för det första urvalet vi gör. Om det inte står något annat i annonsen vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV. Vi har slutat begära in personligt brev eftersom vi inte har med det som del av urvalsunderlaget. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta ansvarig chef för rekryteringen så att din ansökan blir hanterad enligt särskilda rutiner. Du hittar namn och kontaktuppgifter till chefen i annonsen. I denna rekrytering används webbaserade tester som en del i urvalet.


Inom vår IT-organisation är du med och utvecklar Sverige med hjälp av moderna och innovativa lösningar. Vi är mitt i en spännande förändring där vi försöker ta vara på digitaliseringens möjligheter till fullo. Digitaliseringen ställer allt större krav och vi vill därför anpassa oss vad gäller kompetens, arbetssätt och organisation i takt med utvecklingen. Vi har ett helhetsansvar för IT och telekom, en verksamhet som pågår dygnet runt, året om - precis som Sveriges transportsystem.


På Trafikverket jobbar vi med att göra Sverige närmare. Vi tror på att en förening av olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv är den bästa grunden för att bygga en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering och en miljö där alla trivs och gör sitt bästa. Vi tror på mångfald där den gemensamma nämnaren är pålitlighet, engagemang och mod. För det är så vi bäst representerar vårt samhälle.

* Participate in technical discovery, architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, and release activities
* Help troubleshoot complex production issues related to playback, ads, analytics, and device-specific behaviour


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for a passionate and experienced developer with a genuine interest in Android development. If you have experience in working with other clients or TV applications, we would be blown away.
   

  

 You thrive in a high energy, team-driven environment where you love getting stuff done, and having fun while you are doing it.
   

  

**Successful candidates also meet all or some of the following:**
* 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with a strong focus on building and scaling Android applications
* Experience developing customer-focused products
* Strong expertise in Kotlin, Java, or modern Android frameworks
* Good understanding of architecture, performance optimisation, testing, debugging, and maintainable code design.
* Experience working in complex mobile user journeys and if there is experience with video playback, streaming, media apps, we would be blown away.


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Insight into Jetpack Compose and the future of Android UI development
* Experience with advertising technology in media streaming, such as TCF, SSAI, CSAI, VAST, VMAP, ad SDKs, ad tracking, or measurement
* Experience from AVOD, FAST, live streaming, OTT, or other ad-supported video products

 Why join us
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work on a business-critical area where you directly contribute to product quality, viewer experience, and sustainable revenue growth. You will join a team where technical excellence, experimentation, and collaboration are valued, and where your work can have visible impact at scale.
   

  

 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.

title: Senior Android Engineer
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!** 




  





 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
 


* We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities



  





 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





**The role:** 




 As a Senior Software Engineer, Android, you will be responsible for enabling and performing highly efficient application development, improving the Truecaller services for the Android platform. You will be deeply involved in the whole cycle of product development, from idea generation to delivery.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Write code with great code standards
* Deliver complex features on both front-end intensive tasks and performance improvements on the existing codebase
* Cover the code implementations with tests and improve the code coverage
* Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions
* Bring engineering experience to advise product and business teams to make better decisions
* Mentor the junior developers and take ownership of maintaining high engineering standards and a growth mindset in the team.
* Be the point of contact and liaise with the release team on the continuous delivery of high-quality code and the timely resolution of bugs



  





**What you bring in** 



* 5+ years of experience in Android development
* Strong knowledge of the Android SDK (minimum 5+ years of experience)
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs
* Sound knowledge of Kotlin and Java programming languages
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git
* Experience with SQL databases
* Excellent debugging skills
* Fluent in English, in speaking and writing
* Experience working with Agile methodologies



  





**It would be great if you also have** 



* Familiarity with other mobile operating systems, like iOS
* Firebase tools such as remote config
* AB testing, Crashlytics, and user acquisition tools such as Appsflyer
* CRM tools such as CleverTap

 We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting.  Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture.  Behind the code:

 We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
 



  





**We only accept applications in English.**

title: Backend Developer (Python)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every month, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Backend Developer (Python), you'll build the engine room of Filed:
   

  

* The Python services that power tax computation, document processing, and agentic workflows at scale
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The data pipelines that move documents, returns, and evidence reliably through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll own services end to end, from design through production, and see your work carry real weight for some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Designing, building, and operating backend services across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the APIs and data models that the rest of the product is built on
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Making LLM-powered pipelines reliable, observable, and accurate in production
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Strong Python: you've built and operated production services and APIs before
* Deep understanding of building in agent first way, using coding agents daily and controlling LLM driven workflows.
* Strong React/Typescript: you know how to control systems not just backend related
* Solid grasp of data modeling, queues, and the realities of distributed systems
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 3 (Mid-Level). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 68,750 SEK per month + $150,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 75,000 SEK per month + $100,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 81,250 SEK per month + $50,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you know you're suited to a more senior role, don't shrink to fit. Apply to the Senior Backend Developer (Python) role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.
