title: UX-designer till barnupplevelsen i SVT Play
description:
* *Ansök senast: 25 oktober 2026*
* *Stockholm*
* *Hybrid*
***Vad vi erbjuder dig:***

*Vill du vara med och skapa Sveriges bästa videotjänst för barn? På SVT utvecklar vi just nu nästa generations barnupplevelse i SVT Play. Vi söker en UX-designer som vill vara med och forma hur barn hittar, upptäcker och tittar på innehåll, på ett sätt som känns roligt, relevant och tryggt. Du blir en del av ett team där UX, produkt, utveckling och innehåll arbetar tätt tillsammans. Här får du möjlighet att påverka både detaljerna i upplevelsen och den långsiktiga riktningen för hur SVT Play ska fungera för barn.*

***Vad den här tjänsten innebär:***

*Som UX-designer blir du en central del i arbetet med att forma SVT Plays barnupplevelse. Du arbetar med att förstå barns och föräldrars behov och omsätter dem i enkla och engagerande upplevelser. AI är ett naturligt verktyg genom hela processen, från tidig research till färdigt koncept. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med hur vi kan:*

* *designa upplevelser som möter barns unika behov och drivkrafter*
* *hjälpa barn att själva hitta och upptäcka sådant de gillar*
* *skapa en upplevelse som växer med barnet*
* *skapa lättanvända och trygga funktioner som bygger föräldrars förtroende*
* *hitta nya och innovativa sätt att göra SVT Play mer engagerande för barn, där AI kan vara en del av lösningen, både i själva produkten och i hur vi tar fram den*

*Du arbetar från behov och hypoteser till koncept och färdiga lösningar och bidrar till ett kontinuerligt lärande tillsammans med teamets olika kompetenser. Vi testar löpande nya verktyg och arbetssätt för att utveckla både produkten och hur vi arbetar med design.*

***Vem vi tror att du är:***

*Du är en erfaren UX-designer som tycker om att förstå människors behov och omsätta dem i enkla, begripliga och engagerande digitala upplevelser. Du trivs med komplexa problem där det inte finns ett självklart svar och är nyfiken på hur ny teknik, inte minst AI, kan förändra både det vi designar och hur vi designar. Du gillar att testa dig fram, lära och tänka om. Du arbetar gärna nära både användare och kollegor och ser design som något man skapar tillsammans. Du har ett starkt användarfokus och kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer, från att förstå en större produktutmaning till att hitta den lilla förändringen som gör stor skillnad.*

***Vi söker dig som:***

* *har erfarenhet av att arbeta som UX-designer med digitala produkter och tjänster*
* *är van att arbeta användarcentrerat och iterativt*
* *kan omvandla research och användarinsikter till konkreta designlösningar*
* *har erfarenhet av att genomföra användningstester*
* *är trygg i att visualisera och kommunicera idéer, exempelvis genom skisser, prototyper och koncept*
* *har erfarenhet av att samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med produkt, utveckling, innehåll och andra kompetenser*
* *har erfarenhet av komplexa produkter eller tjänster där flera behov och perspektiv behöver balanseras*
* *har erfarenhet av att självständigt planera, leda och facilitera workshops samt driva UX-processer från behovsanalys till konkreta insikter och lösningsförslag*
* *är intresserad av målgruppen barn och har gärna erfarenhet av att designa för barn*
* *är genuint nyfiken på AI och har kommit långt i att använda det i ditt UX-arbete, till exempel för research, idégenerering, prototyper eller för att utforska nya sätt att designa för barn*

***Hur du ansöker:***

*I den här rekryteringsprocessen använder vi oss av urvalsfrågor och CV i stället för att be om personligt brev. Det gör vi för att säkerställa att rekryteringen blir kompetensbaserad och effektiv och att vi får samma viktiga information av alla kandidater*

***Annat som är bra att veta:***  

*Har du frågor om anställningen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Jenny Wester, jenny.wester@svt.se. Facklig information lämnas av Fanny Lindhé (SACO), Maria Nassikas (Unionen) och Jane Andersson (SJF). Samtliga nås via växeln, tfn 08-784 00 00.*

***Vi har riktigt bra förmåner***
---------------------------------

* *Hälsa - Upp till 3500 kr i friskvårdsbidrag*
* *Semester - Du som fyllt 40 år har tre extra semesterdagar*
* *Pension - ITP tjänstepension*
* *Föräldratillägg/föräldralön*
* *Verktyg - Mobiltelefon för privat bruk (exkl. utlandssamtal)*
* *Ledighet med bibehållen lön - Permission 1-2 dagar/år vid t.ex. flytt eller begravning*
***Om företaget***
------------------

***Vi jobbar för hela bilden***

*Från nära till jordens alla hörn. Från förtvivlan till hopp. Från allvar till humor. Vi engagerar, berör och berikar – och gör skillnad på riktigt. Vi drivs av att veta mer och av att komma närmare. Därför går vi på djupet, iakttar, lyssnar nyfiket och låter varje berättelse växa fram. För vi har ett viktigt uppdrag: att skapa ett innehåll som engagerar alla i Sverige.*

*Allt finns innanför våra väggar, från idé och produktion till distribution. Vi vill vara det kreativa navet som driver branschen framåt och när vi behöver samarbetar vi med de allra bästa. Alla roller är lika viktiga och alla är specialister på sin länk i kedjan som granskar, ljussätter, filmar, iscensätter, roar, formaterar, informerar och inspirerar. Vi behöver ständigt locka till oss talanger som ger oss nya perspektiv. Vill du bli en del av berättelsen?*

*Vår ambition är att granska och skildra de frågor som är viktiga för dig. SVT verkar i allmänhetens tjänst och drivs självständigt i förhållande till politiska, kommersiella och andra intressen i samhället.*

*Jenny Wester* *| Kontaktperson*

title: Quantitative UX Researcher
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Quantitative UX Researcher on behalf of one of our partner companies. You connect user evidence, service realities and product constraints to create experiences that are clear, inclusive and valuable.


The partner is strengthening its capability in quantitative product insight that complements behavioural research. You will take responsibility for work that connects survey design, product analytics and experimentation, while ensuring that segmentation and statistics receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The design function values evidence, critique and close collaboration. Success means making complexity understandable and enabling better choices.

### **How you will work**


You will join a multidisciplinary team and move between discovery, design, delivery and learning after launch. The partner expects assumptions to be made visible, prototypes to answer real questions and design decisions to remain understandable when they reach engineering and operations.


This role calls for subject-matter depth and practical ownership. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for quantitative product insight that complements behavioural research.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for survey design and product analytics.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around experimentation.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting segmentation.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve statistics.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering quantitative product insight that complements behavioural research in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of survey design and product analytics.
* Practical experience applying experimentation and segmentation.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving statistics.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from consumer products, marketplaces or digital services.
* Exposure to insight communication in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


You may come from a product company, agency, consultancy or public service. Your portfolio should explain the problem, contribution, evidence and outcome. Direct experience of quantitative product insight that complements behavioural research is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


You will work on consequential journeys where careful discovery can influence priorities, not simply decorate decisions already made. The focus on quantitative product insight that complements behavioural research gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant product, service or customer journey you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
  

Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com  

  

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
  

Learn more about Keet: keet.io

You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Technical Writer
description:
**TL;DR:** Most companies treat documentation as a help centre. At Lovable it's part of the product. Millions of people learn to build software from our docs, and so do the AI agents working for them: the Lovable agent suggests pages, coding tools read them, and our assistants answer from them. You'll be our second technical writer, with product areas of your own from the start and a seat at every launch, and you'll help work out something nobody has fully worked out yet: what documentation should be when its readers are people and agents, and the product changes every day.

**Why Lovable?**


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.


We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What we're looking for**

* You've spent 3+ years documenting software products, and you can show us pages that get a reader to the outcome without re-reading.
* You already write with AI: for research, drafting and checking, not just polish. You know what it gets wrong and you catch it.
* You test what you document. You'd rather try the feature and read the source than take someone's word for it, and when something's broken or confusing, you say so.
* You're at home in docs-as-code: Git, Markdown and pull requests.
* You ask engineers and PMs specific questions, and when documenting a feature shows it won't make sense to users, you raise it early, with reasons.
* **Preferred:** you've shipped docs weekly at a startup or scale-up, finding out what changed yourself. You've written for AI readers, or you're curious about it. You have UX writing or content design experience, or an interest in it. You can read code well enough to check how a feature actually behaves; writing code is not required.

**What you'll do**

* **Drive, don't wait.** Features land every day, and bigger launches several times a month. You find out what's shipping before anyone tells you, and the docs are ready the day it ships.
* **Own it end to end.** Work a feature out from the code and the product, write the page, verify it in Lovable, ship it, and keep it true as the product moves.
* **Care about the reader more than the feature.** Our docs come with data: what people can't find, what the assistant couldn't answer, what support hears. You use it to decide what to write next.
* **Make the product better, not just explain it.** Documenting a feature means using it end to end. You'll find the confusing label or the broken step and get it fixed before launch.
* **Write for three readers on one page.** The non-technical builder, the developer, and the AI agent working on their behalf.
* **Build something that outlasts the week.** AI drafts a lot of our pages. The human work is judgement: what a feature needs, what the engineer didn't mention, and the checks that keep hundreds of pages correct.
* **Where you'll start:**


	+ **Enterprise.** Identity and access, governance, audit, data residency: the pages a security team reads before they sign.
	+ **The developer surface.** Take our API and MCP references from correct to complete.
	+ **Your first launch.** Own the docs for one in your first weeks, from working group to launch day.
	+ **Your first automation.** Pick one check we still do by hand and make it run on its own.

**About your application**


Please submit your application and your writing samples in English using the form below. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.


We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior UX Designer Complex B2B
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Senior UX Designer Complex B2B on behalf of one of our partner companies. You connect user evidence, service realities and product constraints to create experiences that are clear, inclusive and valuable.


The partner is strengthening its capability in complex B2B workflows that help expert users make confident decisions. You will take responsibility for work that connects interaction design, information architecture and prototyping, while ensuring that usability testing and design systems receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The design function values evidence, critique and close collaboration. Success means making complexity understandable and enabling better choices.

### **How you will work**


You will join a multidisciplinary team and move between discovery, design, delivery and learning after launch. The partner expects assumptions to be made visible, prototypes to answer real questions and design decisions to remain understandable when they reach engineering and operations.


This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for complex B2B workflows that help expert users make confident decisions.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for interaction design and information architecture.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around prototyping.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting usability testing.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve design systems.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering complex B2B workflows that help expert users make confident decisions in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of interaction design and information architecture.
* Practical experience applying prototyping and usability testing.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving design systems.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from enterprise software, analytics or operational platforms.
* Exposure to accessibility in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


You may come from a product company, agency, consultancy or public service. Your portfolio should explain the problem, contribution, evidence and outcome. Direct experience of complex B2B workflows that help expert users make confident decisions is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


You will work on consequential journeys where careful discovery can influence priorities, not simply decorate decisions already made. The focus on complex B2B workflows that help expert users make confident decisions gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant product, service or customer journey you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

title: Tjänstespecialist till Mitt gymnasieval
description:
Inera är ett digitaliseringsbolag som bidrar till att utveckla välfärden. Vi är Sveriges digitala ingång till hälsa, vård och omsorg och utvecklar digital infrastruktur för en sammanhållen välfärd. Vi arbetar på uppdrag av kommuner och regioner. Vår vision är världens mest innovativa och omtänksamma välfärd.


Vill du vara med och skapa en nationell tjänst som gör skillnad för elever, vårdnadshavare och landets alla kommuner och antagningskanslier? Hos Inera får du chansen att bidra till en modern digital lösning för gymnasieantagning. Nu får du möjlighet att vara med och etablera och förvalta en nationell lösning som:

* Skapar trygghet och stabilitet i hela processen
* Effektiviserar samarbetet mellan antagningskanslier
* Möjliggör säker delning av data mellan kommuner
* Minskar kostnader och arbetsbelastning för personalen
* Ger bättre beslutsunderlag och statistik
* Gör ansökningsprocessen smidigare och mer transparent för elever och vårdnadshavare

**Om rollen**


I rollen som tjänstespecialist arbetar du nära både kunder och användare. Du ansvarar för att förstå kundernas verksamhet och omsätta deras behov till tydliga och värdeskapande krav för vidareutveckling av tjänsten. Du fungerar som en brygga mellan kundernas verksamhet och den tekniska förvaltningen och arbetar med behovs- och kravanalys av både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.


Du blir en del av ett agilt team som består av tjänsteansvarig, produktägare, systemspecialist, UX och test samt ett applikationsutvecklingsteam med flera olika kompetenser. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår även testning, uppdatering av användarmanualer och informationsspridning.


Du är expert på hur tjänsten fungerar och stöttar våra kunder i olika frågeställningar. Det innebär att du bidrar vid anslutning och införande av tjänsten, hjälper befintliga kunder med frågor och arbetar aktivt med ärenden inom andralinjesupport. Du representerar tjänsten i olika forum, exempelvis kundforum och referensgrupper, och bidrar tillsammans med tjänsteteamet till att forma tjänstens långsiktiga utveckling och strategi.

**Är det här du?**


Du har relevant högskoleutbildning, exempelvis inom systemvetenskap, eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med agil tjänste- eller produktförvaltning, med fokus på behov- och kravanalys. Erfarenhet från att ha arbetat inom antagningsverksamhet är meriterande.

**Varaktighet och tillträde**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Intervjuer kommer ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstidens slut.

Helena Ardehed, sektionschef, helena.ardehed@inera.se

title: Frontend Desktop Engineer (Internal)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***


At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.


But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***


Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.


If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**


Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
  

Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com  

  

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
  

Learn more about Keet: keet.io

**Responsibilities**


In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

  

* Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.
* Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).
* Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.
* Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.
* Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.
* Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).
* Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.
* Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.
* Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).
* Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**
