title: IT-Supporttekniker
description:
**Gillar du att lösa tekniska problem, hjälpa människor och arbeta med IT på riktigt? Då kan det här vara nästa steg för dig!**
 Vi söker nu en engagerad och serviceinriktad IT Supporttekniker till en av våra kunder. Här får du en varierad roll där du kombinerar teknisk problemlösning, användarsupport och praktiskt IT-arbete i en modern IT-miljö.
   

  

 Det här är en möjlighet för dig som trivs med att ha många kontaktytor, gillar att felsöka och vill arbeta brett med allt från Windows och Active Directory till klienthantering, hårdvara och nätverk.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, tekniskt kunnande och riktigt bra service står i fokus. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla dina kunskaper, ta ansvar och bidra till att användarna får en IT-miljö som fungerar i vardagen.
   

  

****Om rollen****
 Som IT Supporttekniker arbetar du med att ge teknisk support och säkerställa att användarnas IT-miljö fungerar så smidigt som möjligt. Du kommer att hantera varierande supportärenden, felsöka tekniska problem och hjälpa användare med allt från datorer och programvara till konton, behörigheter och annan IT-utrustning. Rollen kombinerar traditionellt Service Desk-arbete med inslag av on-site-support. Du kommer framför allt att arbeta i en Windowsbaserad miljö med tekniker som Active Directory, Microsoft 365 och Intune.
   

  

 Här handlar det inte bara om att lösa ett ärende och gå vidare. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, vill förstå varför problem uppstår och gärna hittar lösningar som gör IT-miljön bättre för både användare och kollegor.
   

  

**Det Här Kommer Du Att Arbeta Med**
* Ge teknisk support till användare via telefon, ärendehanteringssystem och på plats
* Felsöka och lösa problem i Windowsmiljöer, både inom mjukvara och hårdvara
* Administrera användarkonton, behörigheter och grupper i Active Directory
* Arbeta med Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams och andra vanliga klientapplikationer
* Installera, konfigurera och felsöka datorer, skrivare, mobiltelefoner och annan IT-utrustning
* Hantera onboarding och offboarding av medarbetare, inklusive konton, behörigheter och arbetsutrustning
* Ge on-site-support vid tekniska problem som kräver hjälp direkt på plats
* Felsöka grundläggande nätverksproblem kopplade till exempelvis Wi-Fi, VPN och anslutningar
* Registrera, prioritera, dokumentera och följa upp incidenter och serviceärenden
* Bidra till förbättrade rutiner, kunskapsartiklar och effektivare supportprocesser


****Vem söker vi?****
 Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för IT och tycker om att hjälpa människor. Du har erfarenhet av teknisk support och känner dig bekväm med att felsöka vanliga problem i en Windowsbaserad IT-miljö. Du gillar att förstå hur saker fungerar och ger dig gärna på nya tekniska utmaningar. För dig är bra IT-support mer än att bara svara på frågor. Du vill hitta lösningar, ge användarna ett professionellt bemötande och se till att problemen faktiskt blir lösta. Du är kommunikativ, strukturerad och har lätt för att samarbeta med både kollegor och användare med varierande teknisk kunskap.
   

  

 Vi tror också att du uppskattar variationen mellan att arbeta självständigt med supportärenden och att vara ute i verksamheten och hjälpa användare på plats.
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Erfarenhet av IT-support, Service Desk, Helpdesk eller liknande användarnära IT-roll
* Goda kunskaper i Windows 10/11 och felsökning av klientmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av Active Directory, exempelvis användaradministration, grupper och behörigheter
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft 365 och vanliga Microsoftapplikationer
* God förståelse för datorhårdvara, kringutrustning och installation av arbetsstationer
* Grundläggande nätverkskunskaper inom exempelvis TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP och VPN
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ärendehanteringssystem och dokumentera tekniska ärenden
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift


 Har du dessutom erfarenhet av
 **Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Group Policy (GPO), PowerShell eller mer avancerad felsökning i Windowsmiljöer** 
 ser vi det som meriterande.
   

  

****Varför ska du söka?****
 För att du får en roll där du faktiskt får använda ditt tekniska kunnande och samtidigt utvecklas vidare.
   

  

 Här får du en varierad arbetsdag där du arbetar nära både tekniken och människorna som använder den. Ena stunden felsöker du ett problem i Active Directory och nästa hjälper du en användare på plats eller hittar en lösning på ett återkommande tekniskt problem.
   

  

**Du Får Möjlighet Att**

* Kombinera Service Desk med praktisk och användarnära on-site-support
* Utveckla din tekniska kompetens och få erfarenhet av flera delar av IT-miljön
* Arbeta tillsammans med kollegor som delar ditt intresse för teknik och problemlösning
* Bidra till förbättringar som gör verklig skillnad för användarna
* Ha en omväxlande vardag med både självständigt ansvar och nära samarbete


****Är du vår nästa IT Supporttekniker?****
 Om du gillar teknik, trivs med att lösa problem och vill arbeta i en roll där ingen dag behöver vara den andra lik, då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig.
   

  

**Skicka in din ansökan så berättar vi mer om rollen, teamet och möjligheterna som väntar!**
**Om CONSULTING It**
 När du börjar hos oss som konsult på CONSULTING it blir du en del av vår gemenskap. Du får dessutom kollegor runt om i Sverige! Du har en dedikerad konsultchef som stöttar dig och din utveckling. Vi hjälper dig hitta nya vägar genom att prova på nya roller och nya branscher, för oss är det viktigt att du trivs på din arbetsplats. Vi ser till att du hamnar på ett bra bolag under ditt uppdrag och att uppdragen ligger i linje med hur du vill utvecklas framöver. Oavsett vad det blir, står vi bakom dig hela vägen – i ditt nästa, nästa och nästa steg. Gå med i vårt team och ta del av en spännande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö!

title: Channel Systems Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Team Our SE team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to security. You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Systems Engineering community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life. Job Summary As a Channel Systems Engineer covering a regional territory, your role will involve providing leadership, technical expertise, and guidance to partners on their journey towards becoming key Palo Alto Networks partners. You will work as a technical leader with channel partners, providing technical expertise to support the technical sales and implementation of company products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with partners, training them on technical aspects, providing pre-sales technical assistance, and ensuring successful integration and post-sales success.. The Channel Systems Engineer will act as a trusted advisor, driving growth within the region by fostering strong relationships with channel partners and ensuring they have the knowledge and tools needed to succeed. We are working to create partner experts for life. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical leader for channel partners within the assigned region Collaborate with focus partners in the territory to develop comprehensive business plans that align to strategic objectives Provide technical pre-sales support to partners, including product presentations, demonstrations and solution architecture design Collaborate with your sales peers to identify opportunities for new partnerships and expand existing ones Plan and drive detailed technical training sessions for partners, ensuring they are proficient in the company’s products, solutions, and integration processes Support channel partners with technical issues during and after product implementation, acting as a liaison between them and the company's technical support teams Applies Business and Technical Acumen to design and deliver customized solutions based on partner and customer needs, ensuring alignment with company standards and best practices Stay updated on product roadmaps, new technologies, and industry trends to better assist partners in growing their business Assist in the development and deployment of channel enablement materials, such as technical guides, manuals, and webinars Collaborate with the product management and development teams to provide feedback on product improvements based on partner and customer feedback Drives results by maintaining detailed records of partner interactions, sales pipeline, and technical support provided, reporting progress to management regularly
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Preferred Qualifications 6+ years of experience in Partner Solution Consulting, pre-sales engineering, or a similar technical role within the technology industry Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE Prior experience working with channel is required. Strong understanding of channel sales models and experience working with resellers, distributors, and other channel partners Previous experience selling, implementing, or managing SaaS offerings is strongly preferred Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions is preferred Prior experience architecting cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence business initiatives is preferred Experience influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex technical information to non-technical audiences Hands-on experience with product installations, configurations, and troubleshooting Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team, managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards resolving issues Willingness to travel within the assigned region to support partners and attend events as necessary Proven track record of influencing key stakeholders and gaining buy-in for technical solutions Proficient in English and Swedish Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent military experience
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: L3 SOC Analyst - Stockholm
description:
Title: Level 3 SOC Analyst
   

  

 Location: Stockholm, 5 days a week onsite
   

  

 Work Hours: 9.00-17.30
   

  

 Job type: Full-Time Permanent
   

  

 Salary: Negotiable / DOE
   

  

**About Us**
 Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by seven Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.
   

  

 With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.
   

  

 At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Job Role / Responsibilities
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a Level 3 escalation point within the MDR/SOC function, providing advanced technical support to Level 2 analysts during complex or high-severity investigations. You will be expected to bring deep operational knowledge across modern security technologies, including SIEM, EDR, Network Intrusion Detection Systems, SOAR, DLP and related security monitoring platforms.
   

  

 The Principal SOC Analyst will support the investigation, containment and remediation of advanced threats, ensuring that incidents are analysed in the correct business and technical context. The role requires strong hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat analysis and detection tuning, as well as the ability to work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to improve detection capability and strengthen cyber security posture.
   

  

 You will contribute to the continuous improvement of the MDR service by supporting the definition of security monitoring strategies, improving detection logic, tuning security technologies, reviewing investigation processes and advising customers on technical optimisation opportunities. A strong understanding of malware behaviour, adversary tactics, techniques and procedures, and emerging threats will be critical to success.
   

  

**Primary Duties/Responsibilities Include**
* Act as the Level 3 escalation point for advanced, complex or high-impact security investigations.
* Support Level 2 analysts during complex investigations, providing technical guidance, validation and direction.
* Perform in-depth analysis of security events, alerts, logs, endpoint telemetry, network traffic and other relevant data sources.
* Lead advanced incident investigations, including scoping, containment, eradication and remediation recommendations.
* Analyse malicious activity, suspicious files, attacker behaviour and adversary TTPs.
* Support customers from a technical perspective in the optimisation, tuning and improvement of their security monitoring capabilities.
* Review and improve SIEM, EDR, NIDS, SOAR and other security tool configurations to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of detection use cases, correlation rules, alerting logic and investigation playbooks.
* Support the definition of customer security monitoring strategies based on risk profile, threat landscape and available telemetry.
* Provide technical recommendations to strengthen customer cyber security posture and improve resilience against current and emerging threats.
* Conduct threat hunting and proactive analysis based on indicators, behaviours, intelligence and attack patterns.
* Document investigation findings, evidence, timelines, containment actions and remediation recommendations in a clear and structured manner.
* Prepare and deliver technical reports to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor trusted sources for emerging threats, vulnerabilities and adversary activity relevant to customer environments.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of SOC processes, procedures, documentation and knowledge base material.
* Develop and maintain proficiency in Integrity360’s MDR technologies, processes, and service offerings, applying this knowledge to improve customer outcome and service
* Support mentoring and technical development of Level 1 and Level 2 analysts, promoting best practices, investigative methodologies and operational excellence across the SOC.


**Desired Skills**
* Strong hands-on experience in Security Operations Centre or MDR environments.
* Deep operational knowledge of SIEM, EDR, Network Intrusion Detection Systems, SOAR, DLP and related security monitoring technologies.
* Strong experience with security event triage, correlation, investigation and escalation.
* Ability to analyse endpoint, network, identity, cloud and application telemetry in support of complex investigations.
* Experience with SIEM query languages and detection logic, such as KQL, SPL, Sigma or equivalent.
* Experience tuning security controls and detection content to improve alert fidelity and reduce false positives.
* Strong understanding of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures, including MITRE ATT&CK.
* Ability to perform host-based and network-based threat analysis.
* Experience analysing packet captures, endpoint artefacts, logs, scripts, documents and potentially malicious files.
* Strong understanding of incident response lifecycle, including preparation, identification, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.
* Strong understanding of enterprise network architecture, TCP/IP, firewalls, proxies, VPNs, DNS, email security and cloud environments.
* Understanding of security protocols, encryption technologies and common authentication mechanisms.
* Experience supporting customer-facing technical discussions, including investigation reviews, tuning recommendations and posture improvement activities.
* Ability to manage multiple complex incidents and make effective decisions under pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk, QRadar, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Palo Alto, Suricata, Zeek, Snort or similar technologies is highly beneficial.
* Experience with cloud security monitoring across Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud is beneficial.
* Experience with threat hunting, detection engineering or purple team activities is beneficial. Ability to produce clear technical documentation, investigation reports and customer-facing recommendations.


**Certifications/Qualifications**
* Security industry certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GNFA, GCTI, GSEC, CISSP, CySA+, SC-200, AZ-500 or equivalent are highly beneficial.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in cyber security, including experience in SOC, MDR, incident response, CSIRT or cyber security operations environments.
* Proven experience handling complex security incidents and supporting advanced investigations.
* Willingness and ability to undertake training on Integrity360's MDR solutions, platforms and operational methodologies.
* Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, SOAR, NIDS, DLP and threat intelligence platforms.

title: GIS Software Developer
description:
**Navigraph is currently looking for a GIS Developer to join our GIS team in central Stockholm. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to work in a developer team in a mid-size company, serving a large and passionate user base worldwide. 🌍✈️**
**About Navigraph**
**Navigraph is a SaaS company that provides aviation fans and aspiring pilots with charts, navigation data, flight-planning tools, and training materials. Our users fly everything from Microsoft Flight Simulator to X-Plane. With our Electronic Flight Bag, virtual avionics, flight planning tools, performance calculators, and teaching material, we’re the trusted co-pilot for any serious virtual aviator.**
**We have specialized GIS data pipelines based on TypeScript, Python and Rust and a modern tech stack for our main apps based on React and React Native. Our mission? To make flight simulation as realistic and immersive as possible by making data, software, and tools like those available to the aviation industry accessible for flight simulation gaming.**
**With our HQ in Stockholm and a global crew of nearly 60 aviation-loving professionals, led by our founders Magnus Axholt (CEO) and Stephen O’Connell (CTO), our team thrives on creativity, experimentation, and collaboration. Join us, and you’ll discover a vibrant community, a thriving business, and a workplace where innovation takes off every day.**
**Check out our** 
**career site** 
**for more information on who we are ✨.**
**What We’re Looking For!**
**We need someone with experience in both GIS and full-stack development who loves solving challenges and writing clean and efficient code.**
**Required Skills**
* 3+ years in a GIS software developer role
* Experience with Mapbox Style Specification, Geospatial SQL, and tools like QGIS
* A knack for open-source tools in the context of geographical data and OpenStreetMap (OSM)
* Experience with backend development in TypeScript, Node.JS
* Experience with Postgres/PostGIS, Python (NumPy, Rasterio, GDAL) and Shell scripting
* Experience with cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Docker, and CI/CD
* Fluent in written and spoken English


**Bonus Skills**
* Experience with development in React.js, React Native, Leaflet, or GraphQL
* 3D modeling
* GRIB files


**Who You Are**
* Passionate about cartography, aviation, or flight simulation
* Friendly and communicative
* Obsessed with detail
* Creative! Always eager to learn and improve


**What You Could Be Doing!**
**As a GIS developer at Navigraph, you'll develop the GIS data pipeline powering our maps and contribute to our Navigraph Charts app. From aeronautical data to weather patterns, you’ll transform raw data into vector and raster tiles that support aviation dreams worldwide. Your work will even be featured directly in Microsoft Flight Simulator!**
* Building data pipelines end to end: Ingest raster and vector sources into PostGIS, transform them, and push them all the way out to the apps. Example: write a script that automatically fetches magnetic declination data, imports it, and keeps it up to date without anyone having to touch it.
* Process raster information into vector data: For example, transform rasterized magnetic declination data into isolines on vector tiles.
* Making maps that look great: Turn dense vector layers into maps that are clear at a glance and a pleasure to look at. Example: design a wind visualization that makes a global forecast feel alive, the kind of layer people screenshot and share.
* Generate and serve tiles at scale: Produce slippy-map tiles for web and in-sim clients, and ensure they're delivered quickly and cost-effectively via our AWS infrastructure.
* Automate data updates: Avoid repetitive work! Make the infrastructure handle all the updates from the source data down to the apps.
* Shipping features users will notice: Deliver map capabilities directly into Navigraph products, and see them in the hands of the community within weeks.
* Designing APIs: Build endpoints that feed both our own apps and third-party developers building on the Navigraph platform.
* Prototyping what's next: Explore and evaluate new data sources, rendering techniques, and tooling. Weather radar, terrain and obstacle data, satellite imagery, 3D, whatever moves aviation visualization forward. Many of our shipped features started as experiments in this team.
* Collaborating closely: Within the team and with other engineering teams, Product, Design, and Tech Leads to keep the platform moving in the right direction.


**What We Offer!**
**Navigraph is built on an open, caring culture where people genuinely come first. The structure is flat, leadership is hands-on, and flexibility is based on trust. Innovation and creativity aren't just tolerated, they're expected. You'll join a team that genuinely enjoys what they do and takes pride in setting the standard for what flight simulation tools can be.**
* Flexible work options: On-site and hybrid
* A great benefits package: please check out our career site.
* Growth opportunities: We’ll support your professional development and provide the resources you need to excel.
* Memorable experiences: The Navigraph team is a tight-knit group with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We enjoy spending time together, and our annual work trips are always combined with team-building activities that leave lasting impressions!


**How to Join the Team?**
**We’re reviewing applications quickly - so don’t leave us hanging too long! 🚀✈️ Apply now and help us take Navigraph - and flight simulation - to the next level!**
 We provide the international flight simulation community with tools and software like those available to the aviation industry. Since the start in 2003 more than 1,600,000 users have registered to access airport and enroute charts, navigational databases, and other useful resources at Navigraph.

title: OT Security Lead
description:
*How do you secure renewable energy assets where industrial control systems, cloud platforms and cybersecurity come together? At OX2, protecting wind, solar and energy storage facilities mean understanding both the technology behind energy production and the risks that come with connected systems. We are now looking for a OT Security Lead to take ownership of our cybersecurity priorities with operational technology at the center and help shape how security is managed across our growing energy portfolio.* 




  





**YOU WILL** 




 OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As the company expands its role as an independent power producer, cybersecurity is an important part of ensuring that its energy assets and the systems supporting them remain secure and reliable.
 



  





 As OT Security Lead, you will take overall responsibility for cybersecurity across OX2's IT and operational technology environments, with a clear focus on OT. You will work across industrial control systems, cloud platforms and corporate IT, setting security requirements and ensuring that risks are understood and addressed throughout the development and operation of energy assets.
 



  





 You will make risk-based decisions about which security measures are needed, where they should be implemented and how they should be prioritized across different facilities. Working closely with plant engineers, IT teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical solutions that work in operational environments.
 



  





 Your main responsibilities will be to:
 



  




* Own and prioritize the CSMS pipeline across OX2's wind, solar and energy storage assets.
* Define security architecture and requirements across OT and IT, including SCADA, plant control systems, remote sites, Azure, AWS and SaaS environments.
* Apply IEC 62443 and security principles such as zones and conduits, secure remote access, least privilege and security by design.
* Establish and enforce cybersecurity requirements for suppliers, technology partners and external service providers.
* Assess cybersecurity risks in vendor selection, acquisitions and divestments, contributing to cyber due diligence.
* Govern external security partners and managed security service providers, including incident response and security delivery.
* Translate NIS2 and relevant cybersecurity legislation into practical security measures across the business
* The role involves collaboration across OX2's international business.



  





**YOU ARE** 




 You have a strong background in cybersecurity. You understand the challenges of protecting systems where security, availability and operational requirements need to work together. You have worked with OT and industrial control systems, including areas such as SCADA, plant networks and remote access. You have practical experience with IEC 62443 and understand how to apply security principles such as network segmentation, zones and conduits, least privilege and security by design. You also understand the connections between OT, corporate IT and cloud environments.
 



  





 Your experience extends beyond individual projects. You have taken responsibility for security across multiple sites or technical environments, setting priorities, assessing risks and ensuring that security measures are implemented. You are used to working with external suppliers and know how to establish requirements and challenge solutions. Experience with MSSP governance, incident response or cyber due diligence is particularly valuable.
 



  





 You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches to security. You make well-founded decisions. You can discuss technical details with engineers while explaining risks and priorities clearly to management. Most importantly, you follow through and make sure security requirements lead to real improvements. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from energy, utilities, industrial automation or other critical infrastructure environments is particularly valuable, but not essential if you bring strong practical OT security experience.
 



  





 At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. You will work close to the technology behind energy production, with the responsibility and autonomy to develop security capabilities that protect both current operations and future assets.
 



  





**WANT TO KNOW MORE?** 




 For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at
 **johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com** 
 or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at
 **artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com** 
 or +46 723 61 28 44.
 



  





 We are looking forward hearing from you!
 



  





**ABOUT OX2** 




*OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.* 




  





*With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.*

title: AI/Dataarkitekt
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga Sveriges cyberförsvarsförmåga?
   

  

 Cyberförsvar ingår i Försvarsmaktens huvuduppgift som en integrerad del av det militära försvar som ska kunna möta ett väpnat angrepp. Cyberförsvaret genomför operationer i cyberdomänen och tillför handlingsalternativ som ligger utanför de reguljära förbandens förmågor. Vår uppgift är att upptäcka, identifiera och avvärja hot från de mest kvalificerade aktörerna inom cyberdomänen. Vi försvarar Försvarsmaktens ledningssystem och kritisk infrastruktur genom både proaktiv uppsökande verksamhet och reaktiv hantering av IT-säkerhetsincidenter. Då vår verksamhet innebär skarp verksamhet inom både offensiva och defensiva cyberoperationer kommer du vara en del i försvaret av Sverige och att stärka vår samlade förmåga inom cyberdomänen. Ett starkt cyberförsvar är avgörande för vår förmåga att försvara Sveriges demokrati och vår frihet att leva som vi själva väljer.
   

  

 Försvarsmakten stärker sin förmåga inom cyberförsvar och söker nu en AI/Datatekniker med placering i Enköping.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett kvalificerat arbete med ett meningsfullt uppdrag – att bidra till att värna vårt öppna samhälle. Vi värdesätter ömsesidigt förtroende och hos oss får du ett eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att kompetensutvecklas.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss och vår verksamhet här: Cyberförsvar
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 Som AI/Dataarkitekt arbetar du med att designa och utveckla långsiktigt hållbar och skalbar arkitektur för dataflöden och AI-lösningar. Du kombinerar ett strategiskt perspektiv med praktiskt utvecklingsarbete och deltar aktivt i att bygga och implementera tekniska lösningar tillsammans med andra. I rollen ingår även att utvärdera nya teknologier, bidra till tekniska vägval samt stödja och coacha kollegor genom att dela med dig av din kunskap och erfarenhet. Du samarbetar nära verksamheten och tekniska team för att omsätta behov till fungerande lösningar.
   

  

**Vad vi kan erbjuda dig**
 Vi kan erbjuda dig meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och ett högre syfte i att vara en del av totalförsvarsfamiljen och försvara Sverige. Möjlighet att bredda din kompetens både inom ditt eget område samt för förbandet i stort. Du ges utrymme till att lösa de tilldelade uppgifterna till den nivå som krävs och lägga tiden som behövs för att lösa dina uppgifter på bästa sätt. En arbetsplats som präglas av en familjekänsla, gemenskap och stark tilltro till medarbetaren och dess kompetens.
   

  

* Tid, möjlighet och verktyg för att kunna leverera resultat i dina arbetsuppgifter.
* Årlig utbildningsplan som du själv har en stor påverkan på, för att fördjupa din kompetens
* Kompetenta och drivna kollegor som jobbar mot ett gemensamt mål.
* Möjlighet att träna upp till 3 timmar i veckan under arbetstid. Hos oss är träning en arbetsuppgift
* Arbetet sker på plats men vi lägger mycket fokus på att du ska ha en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv, där du har möjlighet till flexibel arbetstid


**Kvalifikationer**
**KRAV**
* Flerårig utbildning inom IT eller Data, gärna kopplat till AI, alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet av analys av stora datamängder.
* Du besitter stor förståelse för de grundläggande teknikerna bakom databearbetning.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Svenska och Engelska i såväl tal som skrift.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Som person är du samarbetsorienterad, analytisk och vetgirig. Du arbetar självständigt, tar ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt, samtidigt som gärna delar med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till teamets gemensamma utveckling.
   

  

 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av att utbilda andra inom AI och/eller stora datamängder.
* Doktorand inom AI eller stora datamängder
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta som AI arkitekt, business intelligence eller arkitekt över stora datamängder.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datadrivna utredningar


**Övrigt**
 Anställningsform: Tillsvidare 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas för dig som inte är anställd inom Försvarsmakten.
   

  

 Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid
   

  

 Arbetsort: Enköping
   

  

 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Resor förekommer, både inom och utanför Sverige
   

  

 Du bör inte berätta att du har sökt tjänst hos CFL för andra personer än dina närmast berörda. Anledningen till att vi ber dig vara återhållsam med information är att vissa tjänster vid förbandet omfattas av sekretess. Med anställning följer nationell och internationell arbetsskyldighet. Urvalsprocessen kommer att kompletteras med arbetspsykologiska tester.
   

  

**Upplysningar om befattningen**
 Frågor om tjänsten skickas till:
 **cyberintresse@mil.se**
 Fackliga företrädare nås via:
 **cyberintresse@mil.se**
**Ansökan**
**Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-02. Skicka CV samt personligt brev till** 
 cyberintresse@mil.se
   

  

 Din ansökan ska innehålla CV och ansökningsbrev där du motiverar varför du är lämpad för denna befattningen.
   

  

**OBS! Kom ihåg att ange referens i din ansökan: [9090]**
 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 ----------------------------------------------------- Information om det rekryterande förbandet: I Högkvarteret finns överbefälhavaren och generaldirektören. Högkvarteret har ungefär 1 000 medarbetare – både yrkesofficerare och civila experter. Högkvarteret utgörs från 2023-01-01 av försvarsstaben, operationsledningen, militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten, samt Högkvarterets stabsavdelning och fristående enheter för tillsyn. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Delivery Platforms
description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL**
**You?** 
 A curious and collaborative individual eager to learn, share knowledge, and help developer teams succeed.
   

  

**Role?** 
 Site Reliability Engineer (SRE). You will maintain and evolve our platform, keeping services highly available while making life easier for our developers.
   

  

**Tech stack?** 
 Kubernetes, Google Cloud (GCP), PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code, and observability tooling.
   

  

****Location?****
 Join us in our
 **Stockholm or Oslo** 
 office with the flexibility to work 3 days per wee
   

  

**Company?** 
 Vend Marketplaces, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start!
   

  

**Why us?** 
 This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by supporting over a thousand production changes weekly in a supportive, diverse environment. Enjoy a healthy work-life balance where overtime is rare, continuous learning opportunities, and work with technologies that empower millions across the Nordics.
   

  

 Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
   

  

**WHO ARE YOU?**
* Engineering background: You have shipped code to production and operated services in cloud environments. You know the difference between code that works and code that runs reliably.
* Strong communicator: You explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences and proactively keep stakeholders informed.
* Curious and adaptable: You don't need to arrive knowing everything, but you have a strong desire to learn new technologies and develop your skills continuously.
* Collaborative team player: You enjoy working with others towards a common goal and find it motivating to help your colleagues succeed in a diverse and inclusive environment.
* Knowledge sharer: You actively contribute to discussions about technology and thrive when sharing your expertise to uplift the team.
* Problem solver: You approach advising, planning, monitoring, and diagnosing problems with a flexible mindset.
* English Fluency: You write and speak English well. It is the working language across our teams in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, and Finland.
* Education: A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. We value different paths into SRE.


**WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?**
* Goal and mission: Keep our services highly available and provide an effective, automated platform for all our developers to work with.
* Day-to-day: You will be involved in a variety of tasks ranging from advising and planning to the deployment of new services, as well as monitoring and diagnosing problems. You'll focus heavily on automation, infrastructure as code, and continuous delivery.
* Current projects: Empowering developer workflows through building platforms, scaling our Kubernetes setup in Google Cloud, and exploring/deploying new technologies to support over a thousand weekly production pushes.
* Stakeholders: You'll work closely with internal developers, the wider infrastructure team, and stakeholders across our Nordic marketplaces.
* Communication: Communication is central—you'll collaborate daily with developers, participate in incident response, and help teams understand platform capabilities.
* Observability: You'll help teams understand their systems — building dashboards, refining alerts, and improving logging so developers can troubleshoot faster and ship with confidence.
* AI-assisted workflows: We actively use AI tools to enhance how we work - from troubleshooting and automation to learning and documentation. We're always exploring how to leverage these tools better. You’ll help shape that.


**A few words from Birgir Stefansson, Engineering Manager**
 " We're a team within Vend's Delivery Platforms, distributed across Oslo, Stockholm, and Aarhus, supporting developers across FINN, Blocket, DBA, Tori, and our other Nordic marketplaces.
   

  

 Our team brings together different backgrounds, experiences, and cultures — and that diversity makes us stronger. Being distributed means clear communication is how we work: pairing on solving problems, sharing context openly, and celebrating each other's wins. If you're curious, collaborative, and want to help shape how hundreds of developers ship code every day, I'd love to hear from you."
   

  

 Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!
   

  

**GOT YOUR ATTENTION?** 
 Let us hear from you!
   

  

 Make sure to apply by the
 **31st of October 2026**
**QUESTIONS?**
**Birgir Stefansson,** 
 Senior Engineering Manager, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role via birgir.stefansson@vend.com. You can also contact
 **Clayton Don Corda** 
 , Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, if you have questions about the process.

title: Teknisk projektledare
description:
Är du en strukturerad och tekniskt kunnig projektledare med driv? Vill du vara en nyckelperson i våra kundleveranser och leda strategiska och affärskritiska projekt? Då är detta jobbet för dig!
   

  

 Som teknisk projektledare på Tutus ansvarar du för att planera, leda, styra och leverera projekt som gör skillnad både för Sveriges säkerhet men också för internationella samarbetsländer. Du kommer arbeta nära både våra kunder och interna stakeholders för att säkerställa att vi levererar i tid och med hög kvalité.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:
   

  

* Leda och koordinera projekt från idé till leverans.
* Planera projektgenomförande och resursbehov.
* Säkerställa projektens tekniska och ekonomiska framgång genom bl a löpande uppföljningar och avstämningar på både kund- och leveranssidan.
* Planera och säkerställa genomförande av design, utveckling, systemintegration, test och verifiering.

title: OT SECURITY LEAD TO OX2
description:
*How do you secure renewable energy assets where industrial control systems, cloud platforms and cybersecurity come together? At OX2, protecting wind, solar and energy storage facilities mean understanding both the technology behind energy production and the risks that come with connected systems. We are now looking for a OT Security Lead to take ownership of our cybersecurity priorities with operational technology at the center and help shape how security is managed across our growing energy portfolio.*
 YOU WILL
   

  

 OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As the company expands its role as an independent power producer, cybersecurity is an important part of ensuring that its energy assets and the systems supporting them remain secure and reliable.
   

  

 As OT Security Lead, you will take overall responsibility for cybersecurity across OX2's IT and operational technology environments, with a clear focus on OT. You will work across industrial control systems, cloud platforms and corporate IT, setting security requirements and ensuring that risks are understood and addressed throughout the development and operation of energy assets.
   

  

 You will make risk-based decisions about which security measures are needed, where they should be implemented and how they should be prioritized across different facilities. Working closely with plant engineers, IT teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical solutions that work in operational environments.
   

  

 Your main responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Own and prioritize the CSMS pipeline across OX2's wind, solar and energy storage assets.
* Define security architecture and requirements across OT and IT, including SCADA, plant control systems, remote sites, Azure, AWS and SaaS environments.
* Apply IEC 62443 and security principles such as zones and conduits, secure remote access, least privilege and security by design.
* Establish and enforce cybersecurity requirements for suppliers, technology partners and external service providers.
* Assess cybersecurity risks in vendor selection, acquisitions and divestments, contributing to cyber due diligence.
* Govern external security partners and managed security service providers, including incident response and security delivery.
* Translate NIS2 and relevant cybersecurity legislation into practical security measures across the business
* The role involves collaboration across OX2's international business.


 YOU ARE
   

  

 You have a strong background in cybersecurity. You understand the challenges of protecting systems where security, availability and operational requirements need to work together. You have worked with OT and industrial control systems, including areas such as SCADA, plant networks and remote access. You have practical experience with IEC 62443 and understand how to apply security principles such as network segmentation, zones and conduits, least privilege and security by design. You also understand the connections between OT, corporate IT and cloud environments.
   

  

 Your experience extends beyond individual projects. You have taken responsibility for security across multiple sites or technical environments, setting priorities, assessing risks and ensuring that security measures are implemented. You are used to working with external suppliers and know how to establish requirements and challenge solutions. Experience with MSSP governance, incident response or cyber due diligence is particularly valuable.
   

  

 You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches to security. You make well-founded decisions. You can discuss technical details with engineers while explaining risks and priorities clearly to management. Most importantly, you follow through and make sure security requirements lead to real improvements. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from energy, utilities, industrial automation or other critical infrastructure environments is particularly valuable, but not essential if you bring strong practical OT security experience.
   

  

 At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. You will work close to the technology behind energy production, with the responsibility and autonomy to develop security capabilities that protect both current operations and future assets.
   

  

 WANT TO KNOW MORE?
   

  

 For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at
 **johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com** 
 or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at
 **artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com** 
 or +46 723 61 28 44.
   

  

 We are looking forward hearing from you!
   

  

**About Ox2**
*OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.*
*With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.*

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
**About Hailey 🩷** 




 During the spring of 2020 Hailey HR was founded. We’re a Swedish SaaS HR-tech company that wants to digitalise, simplify and modernise the HR industry with our HR-system - join us on our journey!
 



  





**About the position 💼** 




 As an AI Evaluation Engineer at Hailey HR, you will be a part of our AI development team - working in close collaboration with AI developers, our QA engineer and Product Owners to make sure the AI features we ship are accurate, reliable and trustworthy.
 



  





 We are building a range of AI-driven tools for HR, managers and employees. Building AI features is one thing - knowing that they actually work, and keep working when models and prompts change, is another. That is where you come in. You will own how we evaluate our AI, both before a feature is released and once it is live in production.
 



  





 Our AI features work with sensitive HR data, and protecting our customers' privacy always comes first. That makes evaluating AI quality a real challenge: how do you know an AI feature works well for users without looking at their data? That is the question you will own. If that sounds like a fun problem to solve, keep reading!
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Define, together with the team, what “good” looks like for each AI feature and turn it into measurable criteria
* Build and maintain test datasets for our AI features, using synthetic data and realistic edge cases
* Develop evaluation pipelines that run in CI
* Set up privacy-friendly monitoring of AI quality in production
* Turn evaluation results into concrete improvement suggestions for the team



  





**What are we looking for?** 



* Experienced in working with Python, with an interest in AI evaluation methods and frameworks.
* A person with strong analytical abilities and an interest in statistics and measuring things. Someone curious and eager to learn new technologies and AI models, proactive in taking initiative, and thrives in a collaborative team environment.
* Education: A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering Physics or equivalent field.
* Experience: Around two years of professional experience in software development, data science or test automation, with some hands-on experience working with LLMs. Experience in evaluating AI systems is a plus.
* Language: Full professional fluency in Swedish and strong English skills, both spoken and written.



  





**We believe you are** 



* Flexible and thrives in an innovative and dynamic environment, where solutions are always open to discussion.
* Someone who likes to ask “how do we know this works?” - and then builds the answer.
* Enjoys working in a team, pair programming, and sees the value of code reviews because you work closely with your colleagues in the team.
* Loving table tennis! (or at least find it okay, it’s a part of our culture after all 🏓)



  





**More information** 



* **Process:** 
 We will have an ongoing selection and as part of the evaluation, you will be asked to submit your academic transcripts - please upload them directly with your application. 👋
* **Start:** 
 Whenever you’re ready!
* **Scope:** 
 100%
* **Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden (on-site)



  





 We’re looking forward to your application! 👋 💌

title: IT Compliance Officer, Solna
description:
Are you passionate about turning complex regulations into smart, business-friendly solutions?
   

  

 Do you thrive in environments where structure meets innovation and where your work directly strengthens digital trust across an entire organization?
   

  

 At PostNord, we are on a mission to build a resilient and transparent cybersecurity landscape that supports our digital transformation. As our new IT Compliance Officer, you will be at the heart of this journey and leading our compliance efforts across NIS2, IT General Controls (ITGC), and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. This is a unique opportunity to shape how we govern, report, and continuously improve our IT security posture across the Nordics.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As IT Compliance Officer, you will play a pivotal role in PostNord’s CyberSecurity team. You will take ownership of our compliance framework across NIS2, IT General Controls (ITGC), and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ensuring that our policies, controls, and processes are not only compliant - but effective, scalable and aligned with our business goals.
   

  

**You Will Also**
* Design and operate an integrated compliance program that enables risk-based reporting to leadership and external stakeholders.
* Ensure our controls are well-designed, implemented, and operating effectively — with clear evidence and audit readiness.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and act as a trusted point of contact for auditors and regulators.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, HR, and product/solution owners to translate standards into practical, business-friendly controls.
* Ensure ITGC governance is followed across key stakeholders, and coordinate control execution, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.
* Support OT Security in aligning NIS2 and ISO requirements with operational technology policies and roles.
* Deliver quarterly dashboards and insights to the IT Leadership Team and Group Leadership Team, supporting strategic decision-making.


**Who are we looking for?**
 To succeed in this role, you need to be based in the greater Stockholm area, as close collaboration with teams and stakeholders on-site is an important part of the role. We are looking for someone who thrives in a structured environment but knows how to navigate complexity. You bring a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with a sharp eye for detail and a strong sense of structure. Your deep technical knowledge is matched by your ability to communicate clearly and concisely, whether you are presenting to leadership, collaborating with external auditors, or aligning with internal stakeholders. You build trust across departments, foster collaboration, and know how to turn regulatory frameworks into practical, business-friendly solutions that support both compliance and innovation.
   

  

* A university degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in information security, IT audit/assurance, or risk with at least 3 years leading compliance or assurance programs.
* Expertise in ISMS design and operation, ITGC domains, and control mapping.
* Bonus points for certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISM, or CRISC.

 PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. **Om rollen** 
  

  

 I rollen som tjänstespecialist arbetar du nära både kunder och användare. Du ansvarar för att förstå kundernas verksamhet och omsätta deras behov till tydliga och värdeskapande krav för vidareutveckling av tjänsten. Du fungerar som en brygga mellan kundernas verksamhet och den tekniska förvaltningen och arbetar med behovs- och kravanalys av både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett agilt team som består av tjänsteansvarig, produktägare, systemspecialist, UX och test samt ett applikationsutvecklingsteam med flera olika kompetenser. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår även testning, uppdatering av användarmanualer och informationsspridning.

Det innebär att du bidrar vid anslutning och införande av tjänsten, hjälper befintliga kunder med frågor och arbetar aktivt med ärenden inom andralinjesupport. Du representerar tjänsten i olika forum, exempelvis kundforum och referensgrupper, och bidrar tillsammans med tjänsteteamet till att forma tjänstens långsiktiga utveckling och strategi.
   

  

**Är det här du?**

Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med agil tjänste- eller produktförvaltning, med fokus på behov- och kravanalys. Erfarenhet från att ha arbetat inom antagningsverksamhet är meriterande.
   

  

**Varaktighet och tillträde**

title: Data Scientist
description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad dataanalys och machine learning i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där teknik, automation och framtidens energisystem möts?
 



  





 Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till ett långt konsultuppdrag inom utveckling av intelligenta beslutsstöd och prediktiva modeller för ett komplext och högteknologiskt driftområde.
 



  





**Om uppdraget** 




 Uppdraget är en del av ett större program kopplat till framtidens nordiska balanseringsmodell och utveckling av smartare, mer automatiserade stödsystem för drift och planering.
 



 Fokus ligger på att utveckla:
 


* Prognosmodeller
* Prediktiva och ordinerande modeller
* Beslutsstöd för drift och planering
* Applikationer för flaskhalshantering och budfiltrering
* Produktionssatta ML-lösningar med hög kvalitet och spårbarhet



 Du kommer arbeta genom hela ML-livscykeln – från analys och modellutveckling till deployment, övervakning och vidareutveckling i produktionsmiljö.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Designa och utveckla ML-modeller och prediktiva lösningar
* Implementera pipelines och ramverk för produktion av modeller
* Arbeta med kvalitetssäkring, loggning och reproducerbarhet
* Utveckla applikationer för prognoser och beslutsstöd
* Arbeta med drift, livscykelhantering och förbättring av ML-modeller
* Samarbeta nära utvecklare, DevOps och verksamhet
* Bidra med analyser och scenarier för operativ planering



  





 Du kommer främst att arbeta med:
 


* Python
* Machine Learning
* Docker
* Kubernetes / OpenShift
* Azure DevOps
* Linux
* CI/CD och automatiserade deployprocesser



  





*Detta gäller ett konsultuppdrag med 6 månaders provanställning och därefter tillsvidareanställning. Du kommer bli anställd hos oss på A-Talent Tech Stockholm. Du har samma fördelar hos A-Talent Tech som hos andra arbetsgivare med kollektivavtal och förmåner som pension (med möjlighet till extra flexpension), friskvårdsbidrag och försäkringar.* 




  





**Vi söker dig som har** 




**Krav** 



* Akademisk examen inom exempelvis matematik, statistik, fysik, datavetenskap eller teknisk fysik
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet som Data Scientist
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Python
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Machine Learning i arbetslivet
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade deployflöden
* God Linuxvana
* Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift



  





**Meriterande** 



* Erfarenhet av tidsserieanalys och prognosmodeller
* Erfarenhet av ML i produktionsmiljö
* Erfarenhet av Docker/Kubernetes i produktion
* Erfarenhet av backtesting-miljöer för ML-algoritmer
* Erfarenhet av grafdatabaser eller grafteori
* Erfarenhet från kontrollrumsmiljöer eller samhällskritiska system



  





**Personliga egenskaper** 




 Vi tror att du är:
 


* Driven och lösningsorienterad
* Självständig och initiativtagande
* Kommunikativ och pedagogisk
* Samarbetsorienterad med lätt för att skapa förtroende
* Strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten



 Du har också ett intresse för komplexa system och tycker om att omsätta data till praktiska och verksamhetskritiska beslut.
 



  





**Övrigt** 



* Placeringsort: Sundbyberg
* Uppdragslängd: 2 år
* Säkerhetsprövning krävs för uppdraget



  





**Om A-Talent Tech** 




 A-Talent Tech arbetar nischat med rekrytering och konsultuthyrning av teknisk kompetens. Våra rekryteringsspecialister har god teknisk förståelse och tillsammans med experter inom executive search hittar och rekryterar vi även de mest svårfunna kompetenserna till er organisation. Vi är en del av A-Talent Group, en koncern med specialistföretag inom kompetensförsörjning.
 



  





**Låter det intressant?** 




 Låter det intressant är du välkommen att söka tjänsten. Tillsättning kommer ske löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan! Vid eventuella frågor, kontakta ansvarig Filippa Eklund på filippa.eklund@atalent.se
 



  





 Passa på och ansök idag!

title: Business Developer
description:
Be part of turning strategy into action at the heart of the CIO Office. In this position, you combine business development and transformation with the opportunity to influence how IT works, collaborates, and delivers value across the organization.
   

  

 What’s in it for you?
   

  

* A highly varied position with opportunities to contribute across multiple strategic initiatives and improvement areas.
* Build a broad network and collaborate with colleagues across IT and the business.
* Shape new ways of working while developing your own responsibilities and areas of impact over time.


**About The Job**
 You help the CIO Office translate strategic priorities, transformation initiatives, and improvement opportunities into structured execution and measurable outcomes. Your main focus is business development, while you also ensure stable governance and continuous improvement within IT Asset & Configuration Management.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Drive and support business development and transformation initiatives from definition and planning through execution and follow-up.
* Help execute strategy, improve ways of working, and create transparency across priorities and initiatives.
* Facilitate workshops, innovation days, and other cross-functional improvement activities.
* Create clear communication and follow-up around progress, decisions, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across IT and the business to move initiatives forward.
* Own and continuously improve IT Asset & Configuration Management, including governance, CMDB, data quality, and lifecycle management.


 Location
   

  

 This position is based on-site in Sandviken or Stockholm.
   

  

 Your profile
   

  

 With a practical mindset and a strong understanding of how people, processes, and business priorities connect, you turn complex challenges into clear and actionable plans. You’re comfortable coordinating several initiatives and driving progress through collaboration rather than formal authority.
   

  

 Your background includes
   

  

* A university degree or equivalent experience, preferably within IT, business, engineering, industrial management, or another relevant field.
* Experience in business development, transformation, project or initiative management, process improvement, IT, or a comparable area.
* Proven ability to create structure, prioritize effectively and move multiple initiatives forward.
* Experience working cross-functionally with stakeholders across different parts of an organization.
* Strong written and spoken English.


 Experience with IT Asset Management, Configuration Management, CMDB, ServiceNow, or CSDM is beneficial. Knowledge of portfolio management, strategy execution, product-led transformation, facilitation or innovation initiatives is also an advantage, as is an interest in AI, automation, and modern digital ways of working.
   

  

 You’re proactive and solution-oriented, creating clarity when priorities change or situations are ambiguous. Strong communication and relationship-building skills help you influence, coordinate, and bring people together, while your collaborative approach supports continuous improvement and enables others to succeed.
   

  

 The team
   

  

 You join the Business Support team within the CIO Office. The team works closely across IT and the business, supporting transformation, business development, strategy execution, and continuous improvement through frequent collaboration with different functions and business areas.
   

  

 Our culture
   

  

 Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.
   

  

 Contact information
   

  

 Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Antonia Dåderman, hiring manager, at antonia.daderman@sandvik.com
   

  

 We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.
   

  

 Union contacts (Sweden):
   

  

* Thomas Lilja, Unionen, +46 (0)70-261 04 82
* Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87
* Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-222 48 55


 Recruitment Specialist: Gustaf Sjögren
   

  

 How to apply
   

  

 Send your application no later than October 26th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0097527.
   

  

 We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.
   

  

 To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com

title: Seniora konsulter inom bank och försäkring till B3 Financial Consulting
description:
Vill du arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan affär, regelverk och teknik inom bank och försäkring?
   

  

 B3 Financial Consulting växer och söker nu erfarna konsulter med bakgrund inom bank- och försäkringssektorn. Vi letar efter dig som har arbetat som managementkonsult, projektledare, business analyst eller applikationskonsult och som trivs i komplexa miljöer med höga krav på kvalitet och leverans.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar du i uppdrag där du gör verklig skillnad – från strategiska initiativ och transformationsprogram till operativ leverans i affärskritiska systemmiljöer. Våra uppdrag finns inom bank, kapitalförvaltning och försäkring, ofta med fokus på:
   

  

* Större förändringsinitiativ och programledning (PL / Epic / PMO)
* Strategisk rådgivning inom ditt specialistområde
* Business Analysis, test och agila arbetssätt
* Regelverksdriven transformation (t.ex. ISO 20022, T2S och andra regulatoriska krav)
* Specialiserade plattformar som PEGA, SimCorp och Lumera


 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

* Har erfarenhet som konsult inom bank och/eller försäkring
* Har bakgrund som managementkonsult eller strategisk rådgivare
* Är van att arbeta i regulatoriskt styrda miljöer
* Har erfarenhet av större förändringsresor eller systemimplementationer
* Är trygg i dialog med både verksamhet och IT
* Trivs med ansvar och att driva arbete framåt


 Vi välkomnar både seniora (+15 års erfarenhet) och "semi-seniora" konsulter (+6 års erfarenhet) och värdesätter särskilt dig som snabbt kan ta en ledande roll i uppdrag och bidra med struktur, kvalitet och affärsmässighet.
   

  

 Om B3 Financial Consulting:
   

  

 B3 Financial Consulting är en del av B3 Consulting Group och är specialiserade på bank, finans och försäkring. Vi kombinerar djup branschkompetens med konsultmässighet och ett starkt nätverk.
   

  

 Att vara konsult hos oss innebär:
   

  

* Att arbeta med kvalificerade uppdrag inom bank och försäkring
* Att vara en del av ett specialistteam med hög kompetensnivå
* Att ha stor frihet och eget ansvar i uppdrag
* Att få stöd i din utveckling – både professionellt och affärsmässigt
* Att tillhöra en kultur som präglas av engagemang, entreprenörskap och gemenskap


 Vi tror på långsiktighet – både i kundrelationer och med våra konsulter. Hos oss är du inte en resurs, utan en nyckelperson i vår fortsatta utveckling.
   

  

 Låter det intressant?
   

  

 Hör av dig så berättar vi mer om hur det är att vara konsult hos B3 Financial Consulting.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Product Designer – AI-First
description:
*Objektvision is rebuilding its platform from scratch and is looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape it. If you'd rather ship real UI in Claude Code than polish screens in Figma, this could be your next step.* 




  





**The role** 




 You'll be part of the team building our new customer platform: the tool property owners, managers and brokers log into to list, manage and rent out their space. That covers the obvious parts, like making it effortless to publish a listing, and the less obvious ones: access levels, billing and invoicing, and the view our customer service team works in every day. You need to understand the system behind the screens, not just the screens.
 



  





 The Product Manager prototypes ideas and tests them with customers. Once we decide to go for something, you take over: you design the interaction and UI and build the frontend yourself in Claude Code, so it's close to ready when the Full-stack Engineer picks it up. You'll design AI-powered features like listing quality scoring and matching together with our Data & AI Lead, and help build one shared design system for all markets.
 



  





 You work daily with a Product Manager and a Full-stack Engineer, and you'll have another Product Designer in the company to exchange ideas and feedback with.
 



  





**About you** 



* 5+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped products. A background in development before moving into design is a big plus
* Hands-on with Claude Code (or similar) for prototyping and real frontend work
* Comfortable in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React (or similar)
* Pragmatic and quick to move; you know when something is good enough to ship, and you enjoy finding the best solution together with the team
* Fluent in English; working/conversational Swedish required (team language is English, but daily life at the office is in Swedish)
* Nice to have: experience designing AI features (chat, agents, recommendations), owning a design system, or a marketplace/proptech background



  





**About Objektvision** 




 Objektvision is Sweden's leading marketplace for commercial real estate, part of Finland's Alma Media. They're rebuilding their entire platform from the ground up, going AI-first and shared across markets. Being a small company means they can actually change how they work, not just talk about it. You'll be based centrally in Stockholm, in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with flexibility to work from home the rest of the week. The culture is close-knit and generous - shared lunches, regular offsites, and a wellness allowance, with occasional trips to the team in Finland.
 



  





**Application** 




 We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible. Objektvision is collaborating with Ants for this recruitment. Questions about the role? Reach out to Julia Lagerblad at Ants:
 
 julia.lagerblad@ants.se
