 UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

title: Senior Consultants within performance improvement - for our team in Stockholm
description:
**Company Description**
 We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future.
   

  

 As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.
   

  

 Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.
   

  

 We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.
   

  

**Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.**
**Job Description**
*Do you like helping companies unlock performance improvement opportunities and deliver profitable growth? Would you enjoy working alongside like-*
*minded peers who support each other as a team in a consultancy with a flat hierarchy? If so, you may be the perfect fit for our team. We are now looking for ambitious and* 
*experienced* 
*consultants to strengthen our Operations & Improvement team in Stockholm.*
 Our Operations and Improvement team works with clients across all major sectors. The team works on strategy through to implementation on issues critical to the growth and prosperity of business operations across the world. PA is home to a wide range of capabilities including our Global Engineering and Technology Centres, a strong Digital Strategy team as well as skilled People & Change leaders that allows us to drive performance improvement initiatives for our clients that can uncover opportunities beyond process improvement. Our typical client projects include:
   

  

  

* Enterprise wide cost reduction programs, including design-to-value innovation, cash flow management and sourcing optimsation
* Supply chain network and logistics optimization
* Manufacturing capacity improvement and scaling as well as manufacturing innovation
* Designing and delivering the supply chains and manufacturing capabilities of tomorrow including supply chain digitalization
* Agile transformations


**What You’ll Do**
 Within this role, you will lead the delivery of strategic and complex consulting engagements, including managing teams and senior clients. As a senior consultant, you like to play a key part in business development, sales initiatives and Thought Leadership, with the aim of further expanding competencies and propositions that help to acquire new assignments and clients, and to expand our existing clients and of course, the growth of your own career at PA.
   

  

  

* Drive performance improvement initiatives from strategy through execution
* Analyse performance, identify improvement opportunities and design solutions
* Manage project, drive PMOs and lead change
* Help clients realize business benefits through improved ways of working, digitalization and governance


 We believe value is created through close collaboration with our clients. You will join an international environment that prioritizes teamwork, sparring and continuous learning so we can deliver outstanding work. We are therefore looking for someone with an open and curious approach to solving challenges and who is driven by acquiring new knowledge. Your employment with us starts with a thorough introduction. To support your development, you will from day one be assigned a manager and a buddy who, together with you, will prepare a development plan adapted to your skills and interests.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 We are looking for candidates who are curious, ambitious, and hungry to learn. As you should expect to be managing projects with responsibility for leading other consultants, we are searching for someone with a minimum of 3 years’ management consulting experience or similar.
   

  

 Ideally you will have:
   

  

  

* 5 to 10 years of experience within the area of performance improvement, agile operations, operational excellence or supply chain management.
* Experience from consulting within the sectors of manufacturing, transport and/or defense.
* Demonstrated leadership in large, diverse project teams and the ability to work effectively across all organisational levels, delivering creative and impactful solutions.
* Energetic, positive team player committed to excellence and driven by achieving strong results together.


**Join us if you want to:**
* Work alongside experts in performance improvement, and change management advising decision-makers at global companies
* Take on complex business challenges and gain responsibility early, accelerating your career growth
* Collaborate with colleagues across the Nordics, Europe, and the US in a truly international environment


**Ready to make an impact and grow fast? Apply today.**
**Additional Information**
 If it sounds like a challenge tailormade for you, then apply already today. We will be interviewing continuously, as we want the best candidates for the team.
   

  

 If you have any questions, please contact Sanna Austrell at sanna.austrell@paconsulting.com
   

  

**Inclusion & Diversity**
 We believe that diversity makes us a stronger firm and look to employ people with different ideas, styles and skillsets. This diversity stimulates a rich, creative environment – one in which our people develop, and our clients enjoy enduring results. We’re committed to recruiting, promoting and rewarding our people solely based on their ability to contribute to PA’s goals, without regard to their sex, race, disability, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age or marital status.
   

  

*We welcome international applications, but we are unable to offer sponsorship for work permits, so you will need to have the full right to live and work in Sweden.*
 As part of our recruitment process we use Sterling ADP to carry out background screening checks towards the end of the recruitment process.

title: Account Manager
description:
*Spiris är en av Sveriges ledande ekonomiplattformar för företagare och redovisningsbyråer. Flera hundra tusen företagare får mer tid över åt sin företagsdröm tack vare automatiserade smarta funktioner - allt från bokföring till fakturering och lön.*
 Är du en driven säljare som älskar uppsökande B2B-försäljning och motiveras av att öppna dörrar hos helt nya kunder? Som Account Manager på Spiris tar du täten i att etablera partnerskap med redovisningsbyråer och hjälper dem att framtidssäkra sin verksamhet med vår moderna ekonomiplattform. Här får du stort utrymme att driva affärer från första kontakt till mål i en teknikdriven miljö där vi stöttar dig hela vägen.
   

  

****Som en Account Manager på Spiris kommer du att****
* Identifiera, kontakta och etablera kontakt med nya redovisningsbyråer som ännu inte är kunder hos oss idag.
* Driva hela säljprocessen från självständig prospektering och första möte till strategisk behovsanalys, förhandling och avslut.
* Presentera och paketera lösningar kring vår molnbaserade plattform utifrån byråledningens specifika mål och affärsutmaningar.
* Använda moderna digitala verktyg och AI-stöd för att kartlägga potentiella kunder, förbereda träffsäkra möten och bygga skarpa säljunderlag.
* Samarbeta tätt med kollegor inom sälj, marknad och onboarding för att säkerställa att varje ny kund får en trygg start på samarbetet.


****Vad vi tror att du kan och har gjort****
* Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt driva uppsökande B2B-försäljning hela vägen från kall prospektering till avslutade affärer.
* Du är trygg i värdebaserad lösningsförsäljning och har god vana vid att diskutera långsiktig affärsnytta med partners och ledningsgrupper.
* Du arbetar strukturerat med modern säljmetodik och är van att styra din egen pipeline mot tydliga uppsatta mål.
* Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska i både tal och skrift eftersom du möter lokala byråledare, samt har god förmåga att använda engelska i interna kontakter.
* Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att sälja mjukvara, molnlösningar eller affärssystem.
* Det är meriterande med förståelse för hur redovisningsbyråer driver sin affär.
* Erfarenhet av att använda generativ AI och digitala analysverktyg i ditt säljarbete är också meriterande.


****Förmågor och personliga egenskaper****
* Förhandling och påverkan: Du argumenterar med tydlighet för affärsvärde, fångar beslutsfattares engagemang och skapar affärer där båda parter känner sig som vinnare.
* Uthållighet: Du behåller ditt fokus, ditt driv och din energi genom längre säljcykler och ser invändningar som en naturlig del av säljarbetet.
* Relationsbyggande och empati: Du lyssnar aktivt, förstår kundens outtalade utmaningar och skapar starkt förtroende hos personer som står inför viktiga förändringsbeslut.


****Livet på Spiris****
 Hos oss ska du utvecklas, må bra, göra skillnad och ha kul på vägen. Vi välkomnar dig precis som du är, för vi vet att olikheter gör oss bättre. Vi strävar efter att ligga i framkant – AI och en snabbföränderlig techvärld är en naturlig del av vår vardag. Vi drivs av att utforska ny teknik och söker dig som vill testa nytt och växa med oss. När vi mår bra och utvecklas, kan vi också stötta landets företag maximalt. En sann win-win.
   

  

 Vår hybrida kultur ger dig flexibilitet i vardagen, samtidigt som våra kontor fungerar som viktiga mötesplatser för gemenskap och inspiration. Vårt hjärta och huvudkontor finns i Växjö och vi har även kontor i Malmö, Göteborg och Stockholm. Hos oss blir du en del av ett härligt gäng på omkring 500 kollegor.
   

  

**Intervjuer hålls löpande så vänta inte till sista ansökningsdag med din ansökan!**

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**About Us**
 We’re the world’s leading provider of secure financial messaging services, headquartered in Belgium. We are the way the world moves value – across borders, through cities and overseas. No other organisation can address the scale, precision, pace and trust that this demands, and we’re proud to support the global economy.
   

  

 We’re unique too. We were established to find a better way for the global financial community to move value – a reliable, safe and secure approach that the community can trust, completely. We’re always striving to be better and are constantly evolving in an ever-changing landscape, without undermining that trust. Five decades on, our vibrant community reflects the complexity and diversity of the financial ecosystem. We innovate diligently, test exhaustively, then implement fast. In a connected and exciting era, our mission has never been more relevant. Swift now has a presence in 200+ countries and legal territories to serve a community of more than 12,000 banks and financial institutions.
   

  

 The Swift team, based in Stockholm, is looking for a colleague to help us manage relationships with banks, other financial institutions, partners, and corporates in the Nordics and Baltics. Our goal is simple: to ensure the community of Swift users gets the most out of their Swift products!
   

  

 We are open to different profiles, as we believe that personality is what matters most. Here are some of the profiles we are particularly interested in:
   

  

* Previous pre-sales experience with a strong technical foundation, including a working understanding of APIs and technical solution design
* Knowledge of payment systems, possibly with experience from a central bank, clearing house, or a bank
* Knowledge of Swift from working in a bank and/or as a technical partner to Swift
* Someone early in their career, with experience in managing relationships with larger institutions


 As Account Manager you will also work closely with internal teams at Swift to ensure that customer needs are being met and that the company's overall sales strategy is aligned with market trends.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Develop and manage relationships with key accounts in the financial and corporate sector, including commercial banks, savings banks, fintech and corporates, and other financial institutions.
* Identify opportunities for customers to adopt new solutions and upsell existing ones by understanding customer needs and offering tailored proposals.
* Provide support and guidance to customers on how to optimize their use of Swift products and services.
* Collaborate with internal teams at Swift to ensure that customer needs are being met and that the company's overall sales strategy is aligned with market trends.
* Stay updated on industry developments and trends related to banking and finance, and apply this knowledge when engaging with clients.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and account information using CRM tools.


**Job Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, economics, IT or a related field.
* Proven experience in account management or sales
* Strong communication skills (oral and written) in English.
* Ability to build long-term relationships with clients based on trust and mutual respect.
* Proficiency in CRM systems and MS Office software.
* Knowledge of Swift products and services would be advantageous but not required.


**What We Offer**
*We give you the freedom to be yourself. We are creating an environment of unique individuals – like you – with different perspectives on the financial industry and the world. A diverse and inclusive environment in which everyone’s voice counts and where you can reach your full potential.*
*We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation related to accessibility during your application or interview, please contact* 
*accessibility-Sysgroup@swift.com* 
*or indicate this in your application.*
*Please note that this mailbox is not monitored for general recruitment enquiries and should only be used for accessibility or accommodation-related requests (for example related to vision, hearing or neurodiversity).*
*All requests are confidential and will not affect your candidacy.*
*Don’t meet every single requirement? At Swift, we are dedicated to building a workplace where people can bring their full selves and ideas to the team, so if you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single qualification.*

title: OT Cybersecurity Manager
description:
When you hear digital control systems and production processes, do you immediately think of cybersecurity? Are you passionate about helping organizations secure their industrial environments while contributing to the growth of a leading Industrial and OT Cybersecurity practice in Sweden?
   

  

 Then live your passion in a position where you identify and evaluate security gaps, develop and implement security strategies, and advise customers on the optimal use of security solutions.
   

  

**What To Expect**
 In this role, you will play a key part in growing Accenture's Industrial and OT Cybersecurity practice in Sweden while helping clients secure the digitalization of their control systems and production processes.
   

  

 As an Industrial and OT cybersecurity expert, you will cover relevant subject areas such as integrated governance and risk management, cloud and IIoT security, threat detection and response, network security, and vulnerability and patch management.
   

  

 As a senior member of our Cybersecurity practice, you will help shape and expand our Industrial and OT Cybersecurity offering in Sweden by developing client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, supporting sales activities, and contributing to the development of our OT cybersecurity capabilities and talent.
   

  

 Working closely with clients and colleagues across Accenture's global OT cybersecurity network, you will bring industry insights and innovative solutions to help organizations address evolving cybersecurity challenges in industrial environments.
   

  

 In client meetings and workshops, you leverage your consultative selling skills to act as a trusted advisor and support clients on their cybersecurity transformation journeys.
   

  

**What We're Looking Forward To**
- Degree or equivalent plus at least seven years of experience in process and automation technology and/or cybersecurity, ideally combined with a background in industrial engineering and operational technology.

- Broad expertise in domains relevant to Industrial and OT cybersecurity, including integrated governance and risk management, cloud and IIoT security, threat detection and response, network security, vulnerability and patch management, as well as familiarity with industry frameworks, standards, and regulations.

- Strong business acumen with a blend of commercial, sales, and technical skills, a consultative mindset, and a proven track record of building trusted customer relationships.

- Experience in leading initiatives, developing capabilities, attracting cybersecurity talent, and coaching colleagues in a matrix organization.

- Cross-functional and innovative team player with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

- Willingness to travel as required.

**About Accenture**
 At Accenture, you work with authentic professionals who have one thing in common: a passion for change. We are constantly on the lookout for new employees who have the personality, knowledge, and skills to make our agile and interdisciplinary teams even better.
   

  

 As facilitators, we use the synergy of technology and human intelligence to spark digital innovation and make the world a little better, too. Join our team and help clients seize the opportunities of digital transformation through innovative and secure technology solutions.

title: Junior analytiker inom Cyberhot
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? Vi söker nu en junior analytiker med en teknisk bakgrund och en vilja att utvecklas. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Som junior analytiker inom cyberhot ingår du i en enhet på Cybersäkerhetskontoret. Tillsammans följer och identifierar vi aktörerna bakom angreppen. Vi bygger kunskap om deras tillvägagångssätt och motiv, vilket blir underlag till beslut i kritiska frågor.
   

  

 I rollen som junior analytiker är dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter att:
   

  

* Analysera angrepp och andra företeelser i cyberdomänen
* Bygga kunskap om de mest kvalificerade hotaktörerna
* Rapportera underrättelser både skriftligt och muntligt


 I gruppen har vi en prestigelös stämning där vi delar med oss av våra kunskaper för att bidra till vår gemensamma utveckling. Du har goda möjligheter att styra din tid. Resor i tjänsten kan förekomma.
   

  

 På FRA har vi stark sekretess och det är viktigt att du känner dig bekväm med att hantera den.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Eftergymnasial teknisk/IT eller annan likvärdig utbildning
* Kunskap och intresse av arbete inom cybersäkerhet och analys av cyberangrepp
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


 Vi ser det som meriterande om du har kunskap eller erfarenhet av ett eller fler av nedan områden:
   

  

* Grundläggande kunskaper i programmering – exempelvis skriva enklare program i Python eller andra programmeringsspråk
* Erfarenhet av hotaktörskartläggning eller liknande arbete
* Kunskaper om utrikes- och säkerhetspolitik
* Kunskap och/eller erfarenhet av arbete i Windows och Linux miljöer
* Intresse för CTF:er eller andra tekniska utmaningar, som exempelvis skadlig kod, IT-forensisk eller nätverkstrafik


 På https://challenge.fra.se finns flertalet tidigare utmaningar. Vi ser gärna att du försöker lösa en av dessa så kan vi ha det som diskussionsunderlag på intervjun. Nämn i dina ansökningshandlingar om du löst en utmaning. Maila in din lösning till rekrytering@fra.se, märk ditt mail i rubrikraden med 2025FRA2443-6 Junior analytiker cyberhot.
   

  

 Du är
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Med Följande Egenskaper**
* Samarbetsförmåga – Du arbetar bra med andra människor samt relaterar till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Du lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.
* Utvecklingsorienterad – Du har lätt för att se möjligheter med nya idéer, metoder och arbetssätt. Du är den som driver förändring och ser till att den implementeras.
* Uthållig – Du arbetar tills projekt är avslutade och resultat uppnådda. Vid motgång behåller du din effektivitet och motivation.
* Problemlösande analysförmåga – Du arbetar bra med komplexa frågor genom att analysera och bryta ner problem i mindre delar. Du ser mönster och lösningar som andra kan missa.


 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.
   

  

 Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.
   

  

 FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se . För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se
   

  

 För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.
   

  

 Mer information
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Innan en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. I denna rekryteringsprocess kommer arbetsprov/tester att tillämpas. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekrytering@fra.se. Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.
   

  

 Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se
 **senast 2026-11-08.**
 Referensnummer
 **2025FRA2443-6.**
 Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.
   

  

 Sökord: malware, statsaktör, pcap

title: Identity & Access Management Advisory and Delivery Lead
description:
Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö, Sweden
   

  

  

- Hybrid

- Fluent Swedish and English

**The role**
 You'll guide how large organisations transform their identity and access, advising their security and technology leaders on where to go, and running the programmes that take them there. You'll build long-term relationships, understand what a client actually needs, and shape work that creates real value for them. The trust this role rests on is earned through two things: the technical credibility to engage on complex topics without reaching for a script, and the judgement to own outcomes in environments that are rarely tidy. Increasingly that includes helping clients prepare for and benefit from AI securely. Deciding who and what can act on a system is not a technical detail at this level — it's a strategic one, with regulatory and commercial weight. You'll carry both the delivery and the relationship across a varied client portfolio, and contribute to growing the practice in the process.
   

  

**About Accenture Cybersecurity**
 At Accenture Cybersecurity, we help organisations protect what matters most by combining deep security expertise with leading technology. We support our clients across the entire security journey, from strategy and advisory to implementation and managed security services, helping them navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape with confidence.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
- Advise senior client stakeholders on their identity and access direction, and develop the strategy and operating model with them.

- Lead the delivery of complex transformation programmes, owning the outcome end to end.

- Build and hold long-term client relationships, understanding their needs in depth and earning the right to be the person they call.

- Shape and win new work, developing a sharp point of view on what clients in your sectors need and translating that into proposals and engagements.

- Invest in growing the capability and the people in it.

**What We're Looking For**
- A track record in cybersecurity — from consulting or in-house — with the depth to be trusted by senior stakeholders and the breadth to lead across the identity landscape rather than a single product such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Ping or Microsoft Entra ID.

- Experience developing business and client relationships, ideally within consulting or IT/security services — the ability to understand what a client needs and to shape an engagement around it.

- Enough commercial awareness to contribute to shaping and winning work, and to understand the business context behind a client's security decisions.

- Around 10+ years of relevant experience.

- Fluent Swedish and English.

- Based in Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö, on a hybrid pattern.

**Nice to have**
- A relevant degree, ideally with a postgraduate qualification.

- Senior security certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001).

- A track record of leading large-scale identity or security transformation for complex enterprises, and of shaping the commercial side of that work.

- Experience growing a capability: bringing people in, developing them, and building a team with something to offer.

**Location & working**
 Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö
   

  

  

- Hybrid.

**What We Offer**
 A place to grow and learn, leading work that clients rely on, alongside a Sweden-based identity team within Accenture's wider security practice. The role has the weight that comes with genuine senior client ownership — the relationships you build and the programmes you lead tend to have a long tail. You'll do it with the scale of a global firm behind a long career and the scope to move across industries and geographies. As organisations transform and adopt AI, the demand for leaders who can make identity trustworthy at scale — and who understand why it matters — only grows.
   

  

**Interested?**
 Apply via the link on this page.
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world's leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

 We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

title: Säkerhetsskyddsspecialist
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
 Din rol
 **l**
 Som säkerhetsskyddsspecialist på Saab Surveillance kommer du att arbeta i en internationell miljö där avancerade säkerhetshot är en del av vardagen, tillsammans med komplexa affärsmiljöer.
   

  

 Du kommer ha en viktig roll för att stärka organisationens förmåga att skydda säkerhetsskyddskänslig verksamhet, genom att bland annat säkerställa efterlevnad av gällande lagstiftning, myndighetskrav och interna styrande dokument. Du kommer fungera som specialist och rådgivare inom säkerhetsskyddsarbete och bidra till utveckling, implementering och uppföljning av verksamhetens säkerhetsskydd.
   

  

 I ditt arbete kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Genomföra och uppdatera säkerhetsskyddsanalyser.
* Identifiera skyddsvärden, hot, sårbarheter och skyddsbehov.
* Bedöma konsekvenser vid exponering av säkerhetskänslig verksamhet.
* Delta i riskanalyser och säkerhetsbedömningar.
* Upprätta och granska säkerhetsskyddsavtal (SUA).
* Delta vid upphandlingar som omfattar säkerhetsskydd.


*Placeringen för denna tjänst är i Stockholm eller Göteborg.*
 Din profil
   

  

 Personliga egenskaper kommer att vara av stor betydelse och för att du ska trivas i denna roll behöver du vara lösningsorienterad, nyfiken och noggrann.
   

  

 Det är av största vikt att du är pålitlig med stark etik och personlig integritet.
   

  

 Du är självständig med god självinsikt och har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande och en god förmåga att hantera tempoväxling.
   

  

 En stor del av arbetet kommer ske i mycket nära samarbete med andra interna och externa aktörer vilket ställer höga krav på din förmåga att bygga och behålla goda relationer. Du är ansvarstagande och kan självständigt prioritera dina uppgifter. Du bidrar aktivt till en trivsam arbetsmiljö.
   

  

 Resor till platser där vi har verksamhet är en viktig del av tjänsten och är i perioder omfattande.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av säkerhetsskyddsarbete.
* God kunskap om säkerhetsskyddslagen, säkerhetsskyddsförordningen och säkerhetspolisens / Försvarsmaktens föreskrifter om säkerhetsskydd
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsskyddsanalyser.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetskänslig verksamhet.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagstiftningen.


 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet från försvarsindustri eller myndighet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med SUA.
* Certifieringar inom säkerhet, informationssäkerhet eller riskhantering.
* Erfarenhet av NIS2, ISO 27001 och cybersäkerhetsarbete.


*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här
   

  

 Om du är intresserad av vilka förmåner som du kan ta del av som anställd på Saab i Sverige, kan du läsa om dem här
   

  

 Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

title: Senior Associate Audit Analytics & Data Insights | Assurance | Stockholm
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Would you like to use data analytics, automation and visualization to create clear insights in audit and assurance engagements?
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As a Senior Associate in Audit Analytics & Data Insights, you will deliver analytics that strengthen audit quality and risk identification. You will work with complex datasets and translate requirements from audit teams and stakeholders into clear, well-documented analytical outputs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver analytics through financial, operational and compliance engagements.
* Extract, transform and analyze large datasets using SQL, Databricks and Alteryx.
* Build reusable workflows and automated routines that improve efficiency and consistency.
* Create dashboards and visualizations in Power BI or comparable tools.
* Perform data-quality assessments, reconciliations, trend analysis and exception reporting.
* Document data sources, transformation logic, testing, assumptions and findings in a clear, auditable manner.


**Qualifications**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* Approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience in audit analytics, data analytics, business intelligence or a related field.
* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including queries, data transformation and validation of large datasets.
* Experience preparing analytics for audit or assurance, with knowledge of risks, controls and audit evidence.
* Experience with data visualization, preferably Power BI, and the ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.


**Meritorious**
* Experience with Alteryx, Databricks, SAP or Oracle.
* Knowledge of Purchase-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, process mining, continuous monitoring or Python.
* Experience with audit automation, AI, and data-driven audit methodologies, including the application of analytics, process mining, workflow automation, and AI-enabled tools to enhance audit quality, efficiency, and risk identification.
* A relevant qualification or certification in audit, accounting, information systems or analytics.


**As a person you are**
* Structured, curious and solution-focused.
* Comfortable working with others and clear in your communication.

title: Graduate & Junior Consulting Professionals
description:
**Are you a recent graduate or about to graduate from university? Are you interested in helping organizations solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful change?**
 Accenture's Consulting graduate track is designed for graduates who want to build a career at the intersection of business transformation, industry expertise and technology. From day one, you'll work alongside experienced consultants on real client challenges, helping organizations improve how they operate, adapt to change and create lasting business value.
   

  

 As part of the graduate track, you'll gain hands-on experience, continuous coaching and mentorship, and develop the consulting, analytical and leadership skills needed to thrive in a rapidly changing business environment. You'll also learn how organizations are applying AI, data and technology to improve decision-making, enhance performance and create new sources of value.
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping organizations reinvent through strategy, consulting, technology and operations. We combine industry, functional and technology expertise to help clients turn ambition into measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 Accenture offers graduate opportunities across Technology, AI & Data, Strategy and Consulting.
   

  

**About The Consulting Graduate Track**
 The Consulting graduate track focuses on helping organizations translate business ambitions into practical action and sustainable business outcomes.
   

  

 Depending on your team and project assignments, you may work on challenges with either an industry or functional focus, such as supply chain, finance, customer transformation, workforce transformation and AI-enabled enterprise transformation.
   

  

 Consulting focuses primarily on helping organizations improve performance, redesign how work gets done and translate strategic ambitions into operational results.
   

  

 Consulting helps organizations answer questions such as:
   

  

  

- How can we improve performance and efficiency?

- How can we create more value through better processes and operations?

- How can we simplify and improve the way we work?

- How can we adapt our organization to changing business needs?

- How can we leverage AI, data and technology to enhance business performance?

- What operating models, processes or capabilities are needed to achieve our ambitions?

- How can we successfully implement change and realize business value?

**Consulting Topics and Focus Areas**
 Depending on your team and area of specialization, you may work with topics such as:
   

  

  

- Business Transformation

- Process Excellence & Optimization

- Supply Chain & Operations

- Finance Transformation

- Customer & Commercial Transformation

- Workforce & Talent Transformation

- Digital Core Transformation

- AI-enabled Enterprise Transformation

 Over time, you'll build broad consulting capabilities while developing deeper expertise in selected transformation areas.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As part of project teams, you'll help clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 Examples of work may include:
   

  

  

- Supporting business transformation programs

- Analyzing challenges across people, processes, technology and data

- Conducting stakeholder interviews, workshops and research

- Identifying opportunities to improve performance and create value

- Supporting organizational change and adoption initiatives

- Helping redesign business processes and operating models

- Defining and documenting business requirements

- Applying data, analytics and AI-enabled approaches to support decision-making

- Developing recommendations, business cases and presentations for client stakeholders

- Helping turn recommendations into implementation roadmaps and action plans

 You will work closely with experienced consulting teams while receiving ongoing coaching to support your development.
   

  

**What's In It for You?**
 Joining the Consulting graduate track provides:
   

  

  

- A dedicated consulting-focused graduate track

- Early exposure to complex business challenges

- Extensive training, coaching and mentorship

- Opportunities to develop AI capabilities and understand how AI is reshaping business operations and decision-making

- Exposure to senior stakeholders and high-impact transformation programs

- Access to Accenture's global expertise and knowledge networks

- A strong foundation for a long-term career in consulting and business transformation

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We're looking for curious, ambitious and analytically minded graduates who enjoy solving complex problems and working with others.
   

  

 You:
   

  

  

- Have a master's degree or will receive your degree before September 2027

- Can start at Accenture in early autumn 2027

- Have strong academic results in a relevant field

- Are an analytical problem-solver with strong business acumen

- Have an interest in consulting, transformation, operations or business development

- Are curious about how organizations operate and create value

- Are interested in how AI, data and technology are transforming business performance

- Have strong written and verbal communication skills

- Are collaborative, proactive and eager to learn

- Are fluent in English and Swedish, both verbally and in writing

 Relevant educational backgrounds may include Business & Economics, Industrial Engineering & Management, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Human Resources and related disciplines.
   

  

**Office and Start Date**
 We are recruiting graduates to our offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö, with a start date in early autumn 2027. Depending on the assignment, work may take place from an Accenture office, a client location or remotely as part of multidisciplinary teams. Flexibility and mobility are therefore expected.
   

  

**Application Process**
 Please submit:
   

  

  

- CV including GPA on a five-grade scale

- Cover Letter

- University Transcripts/Grades

**Please upload all documents under Upload Resume/CV.**
 Only complete applications will be reviewed.
   

  

 In your cover letter, we would like to learn:
   

  

  

- Why you are interested in Consulting

- Which transformation topics interest you most

- Relevant academic, professional, extracurricular or leadership experiences

- Which office location you are applying to

 The screening and selection process is conducted on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 Candidates progressing to the next stage will be invited to complete assessments designed to evaluate analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming the next generation of consulting professionals to Accenture.

title: Industrial Transformation Director – Netherlands & Nordic Industrials, Sweden
description:
Accenture's Industrials Reinvention Partner practice works with the region's most complex and consequential industrial companies — and we're growing fast. We combine deep industry insight, AI-led business strategy and a full suite of reinvention capabilities to help our clients fundamentally transform how they create value.
   

  

 We are seeing unprecedented demand across our Nordic and Netherlands portfolio — spanning industrial equipment, automotive, aerospace & defence, and transport & logistics — and we are looking for a senior transformation leader who becomes the dedicated reinvention partner on one or two of our most important accounts, drives large-scale programs, and builds the commercial relationship from that position.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a senior member of our industrials team, you will:
   

  

  

- Serve as the senior reinvention partner presence on one or two priority industrial accounts — going deep, not broad

- Lead large, complex transformation programs end-to-end, from business case through execution

- Be the senior I&E face at the account — present in the room, trusted by the C-suite, closely aligned with account leadership

- Identify and originate the next wave of opportunities from within the account, selling from a position of demonstrated impact

- Build, lead and develop the delivery team on the ground

- Work closely with Accenture's global capability network to bring the right expertise to your clients at the right moment

**What We Are Looking For**
- 7+ years of experience leading large-scale industrial transformation programs, with full accountability for delivery, outcomes and senior client relationships

- Proven ability to run complex, multi-workstream programs in industrial environments — and keep senior stakeholders aligned throughout

- Experience selling from an account — identifying the next opportunity, shaping it with the client, and closing it

- Deep knowledge of one or more transformation domains: operational reinvention, AI-led enterprise transformation, cost and productivity programs, operating model redesign, or technology-led change

- Established executive relationships in the Nordic or Netherlands industrial market — you are known, not just experienced

- The credibility to engage a COO, CFO or divisional CEO as a peer, and the delivery instinct to back it up

- Master's degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline

- Fluency in English; Nordic or Dutch language skills a strong plus

- Based in Helsinki, Stockholm, Gothenburg, or Amsterdam; willingness to travel

**What's In It For You**
- A high-impact role with dedicated account focus — you go deep and build something lasting, not wide and thin

- The backing of Accenture's full industrial capability, ecosystem and global network

- The opportunity to become the trusted reinvention partner at a marquee Nordic or Netherlands industrial client

- Strong peer group of senior industry leaders across EMEA and globally

- Continuous development through mentoring, global knowledge networks and hands-on reinvention work

- Competitive compensation and benefits, and flexible work-life arrangements

- A culture that values both performance and people — without trading one for the other

**Apply Now**
 Submit your CV and cover letter in English. Applications are reviewed continuously. While we welcome applications throughout the summer, our recruitment process will resume in August following the holiday period. We encourage you to apply now and look forward to reviewing your application in August.

title: Management Consulting Manager - Finance
description:
**Are you an experienced finance transformation leader who wants to drive real reinvention for some of Sweden’s most complex organizations? Are you highly motivated to shape the AI-driven future of finance – and build a practice around it?**
 Accenture’s Finance Strategy & Consulting practice would like to hear from you!
   

  

 As part of Accenture’s Finance practice you will help organizations reinvent their finance functions and unlock new value – making Reinvention part of your career and your clients’ future.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Strategy and/or Management Consulting Manager or Senior Manager** 
 for our
 **Finance practice** 
 in Sweden (Stockholm, Gothenburg or Malmö).
   

  

 To succeed in the role you are a driven, ambitious, and proactive leader who thrives on both drawing the bigger picture and owning the outcome. You bring deep finance expertise, a hands-on delivery mindset, and the ability to build trusted relationships at CFO and senior finance executive level. You will own client relationships, drive business development and originate new opportunities, lead teams and workstreams, and ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction. As a Manager or Senior Manager you will also help shape our Swedish Finance practice, coach and develop junior colleagues, and contribute to growing the team.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
- Finance operating model design and GBS/shared service center establishment – defining target operating models, governance frameworks, and transformation roadmaps that move finance from scorekeeper to strategic value architect

- Finance platform transformation – leading ERP and finance application modernization programmes (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Workday, OneStream, Anaplan) that build an AI-ready digital core and streamline data models

- Strategic finance operations – redesigning end-to-end finance processes, driving standardization, and building high-performance Finance & Accounting capabilities through GBS and intelligent operations

- AI and automation reinvention – designing and implementing GenAI and agentic automation in finance operations, building Human + Machine finance teams, and embedding AI across the finance function in a responsible and audit-compliant way

- Enterprise performance management and connected planning – replacing static budgets with AI-driven forecasting, scenario modelling, and decision intelligence that gives CFOs and business leaders a true forward-looking view

- Business development and client leadership – originating and leading proposals, building and owning relationships at CFO and Controller level, and actively shaping our Finance practice in Sweden

- Strategic cost reduction, operational efficiency, and enterprise value creation – identifying and realizing measurable financial outcomes through transformation programmes

**What´s In It For You**
- Truly competitive salary terms, bonus schemes, pension, health insurance, employee stock purchase program etc.

- Work-life balance is important to us. Volunteer roles and events through our internal networks

- Access to several social activities through active corporate sports community

- A variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you acquire and build specialized skills faster

**To succeed in this role, we believe you have:**
- A Master’s degree in a relevant field, e.g. Accounting, Finance or Industrial Engineering with excellent academic performance

- 5+ years (Manager) or 8+ years (Senior Manager) of strategy and/or management consulting experience related to the CFO Agenda – e.g. finance transformation, GBS design and establishment, enterprise performance management, finance operating model or platform transformation – ideally gained at a Big Four or comparable strategy/management consultancy

- A proven track record of leading teams and workstreams, managing senior client stakeholders, and contributing to business development, proposals and sales – with greater commercial ownership expected at Senior Manager level

- Experience working with AI and digital tools in a finance or consulting context – including an understanding of how GenAI, agentic automation and data analytics are reshaping the finance function

- Experience from diverse projects and cross-functional teams, with the ability to work across industries and client contexts

- Fluent in English (incl. experience with written and oral presentations in English) and Swedish, with experience conducting interviews and facilitating workshops

**The position will report to the Finance Practice Lead and the workplace is Sweden (Stockholm, Gothenburg or Malmö). Some travel should be expected.**
**Interested?**
 Apply online by attaching your CV, application letter and educational diplomas as soon as possible.
 **We look forward to receiving your application.**
**About The Finance Practice In Accenture**
 Finance is one of Accenture’s seven Reinvention Partners – dedicated units bringing end-to-end capabilities to help clients reinvent core aspects of their business. Our Finance team helps organizations reinvent their financial performance by supporting the full CFO agenda: driving efficiency, enabling AI-powered and data-driven decision-making, and building world-class finance functions fit for a digital and AI-driven world. We work across strategy, consulting and delivery – from target operating model design through to programme execution and managed operations.
   

  

 We are looking to enhance our team to engage them in areas of:
   

  

**Enterprise performance management** 
 – Develop integrated, cloud-enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions.
   

  

**Finance operations & GBS** 
 – Design and establish high-performing finance operating models, shared service centers and Global Business Services (GBS) organizations that deliver scalable, agile Finance & Accounting capabilities anytime, anywhere.
   

  

**Finance Platform Transformation** 
 – Help finance organizations secure the opportunity to take their system implementation to the next level by developing harmonized and standard processes and streamlining their data models.
   

  

**Enterprise Value** 
 – Identify and realize value for the enterprise and help drive measurable outcomes through digital investments at the right pace and scale.
   

  

**Enterprise Analytics** 
 – Help CFOs to become more data-driven to provide insights enabling true business partnering in Finance required for sustainable growth and decision-making
   

  

**Automation and AI** 
 – Help organizations become leading-edge companies utilizing generative AI, agentic AI, and process and task mining to automate and transform finance processes

title: VP of Customer Success
description:
This is not a typical Customer Success role. You'll own net revenue retention across renewals, expansion, training, and customer marketing for a global customer base, with a direct line into shaping the product itself.
   

  

 We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.

* Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 140 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.
* High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.
* A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.

* Build a structure across Account Management, Training, Professional Development and Customer Marketing with clear roles and no major gaps or overlaps
* Own, develop and implement the CS strategy and post-sales processes across markets, with full decision-making authority over prioritisation, team structure and resource allocation

* Advise the leadership team on Customer Success strategy and forecasts alongside the CRO, and lead cross-team collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Product, Content and Enablement

* Discovery call with a Recruiter

* References


 Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
