title: Plattformsingenjör/DevOps inom säkra system
description:
**Var med och bidra till ett säkrare samhälle!** 




 Vad händer när säkerhet inte är en efterhandskonstruktion – utan själva utgångspunkten?Det är verkligheten vi jobbar i varje dag. Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som Plattformsingenjör/DevOps. Hos oss utvecklar du inte bara teknik som fungerar idag, du bygger lösningar som ska hålla över tid. Tillsammans med erfarna kollegor arbetar du med plattformar, automation och infrastruktur i miljöer där säkerhet, robusthet och kvalitet aldrig är kompromisser.
 



 Vi utvecklar marknadens säkraste IT-plattform, Craton, för organisationer med de högsta skyddskraven. Som en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom verksamhets och säkerhetsskydd hjälper vi samhällsviktiga verksamheter att stå starka även när omvärlden ställer höga krav. Nu fortsätter vi att växa och söker fler som vill vara med på resan. Du kan läsa mer om Craton
 
 här.
 




  





**Om rollen** 




 Vi söker nu plattformsingenjörer/DevOps till våra olika team. Oavsett team finns möjlighet att forma din roll utifrån intresse, kompetens och långsiktig inriktning. Hos oss får du arbeta med engagerade kollegor som kombinerar hög teknisk kompetens med ett genuint engagemang för samhällets säkerhet.
 



  





**Våra team** 




*Engineering* 




 I Engineering-teamet arbetar du med produktutvecklingen av Craton som plattform. Vi bygger infrastruktur och tjänster iterativt, med tekniska lösningar som fungerar idag och håller över tid. Vårt arbetssätt präglas av principen
 *"make it work, make it repeatable, make it fast"* 
 där infrastruktur och konfiguration definieras som kod.
 



 Du kommer att bygga, konfigurera och installera infrastruktur och mjukvara samt felsöka problem genom hela teknikstacken – från applikationer ner till kärnan på hypervisorn. Plattformen driftsätts i kundernas egna anläggningar, utan yttre nätverksanslutning, vilket ställer höga krav på kvalitet, robusthet och automation.
 



  





*Defence Systems* 




 I Defence Systems arbetar du nära en specifik kund i en säkerhetskritisk miljö med mycket höga krav. I rollen har du kontinuerlig och nära kommunikation med kunden, där du ansvarar för att utveckla och leverera kundanpassade lösningar. Teamet är under uppbyggnad, vilket innebär att du får en unik möjlighet att bidra till teamets utveckling från grunden.
 



  





**Din bakgrund** 




 Vi tror att du trivs med att samarbeta och gärna delar med dig av dina erfarenheter och kunskaper till andra. Du uppskattar att fungera som ett bollplank för kollegor och bidra till ett öppet lärande i teamet. För oss är viljan att bidra till teamets utveckling minst lika viktig som erfarenhet av specifika tekniker och verktyg.
 



 Vidare ser vi att du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i större tekniska team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvarstagande är en naturlig del av vardagen
* Erfarenhet av att stötta, coacha eller mentorera kollegor och ett genuint intresse för att hjälpa andra att utvecklas
* Flera års erfarenhet av plattformsutveckling, DevOps, systemutveckling eller närliggande områden
* God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att sätta dig in i nya tekniker, plattformar och verktyg
* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, systemutveckling eller liknande område, alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom erfarenhet
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift



  





 Meriterande
 


* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform, Ansible eller liknande verktyg
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes eller andra containerplattformar i produktionsmiljö
* Erfarenhet av att sätta upp komplex nätverksarkitektur och DNS i större system.



  





**Placering och säkerhet** 




 Vi har kontor i centrala Stockholm och i Enköping och du utgår från det kontor som passar dig bäst.
 



 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande. Eftersom våra kunders verksamhet kräver det och flera av våra anställda är placerade i säkerhetsklass är svenskt medborgarskap ett villkor för att arbeta på Basalt.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder** 




 För att ge dig trygghet och stabilitet erbjuder vi ett förmånspaket som inkluderar en av marknadens bästa pensionslösningar, omfattande försäkringar, förstärkt föräldralön och ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr/år. Vi erbjuder kontinuerliga möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och du får även tillgång till Benifex, där du kan hitta en mängd extra förmåner. Vi erbjuder tjänstledighet med löneutfyllnad för medarbetare som tjänstgör inom Försvarsmakten, inklusive GSS/T, reservofficerare och hemvärnssoldater.
 



 Vi värnar om balansen mellan arbete och fritid. Med flexibla arbetstider, 5-timmars arbetsdag innan helgdagar och ledigt på klämdagar ser vi till att du har tid för både ditt jobb och ditt privatliv. Dessutom anordnar vi gemensamma aktiviteter, såsom skidresor, träningspass och sociala luncher, för att stärka sammanhållningen och göra arbetsplatsen ännu trevligare.
 



 Vi strävar efter att du ska känna stolthet och trivsel hos oss på Basalt. Du kan läsa mer om våra förmåner och om hur det är att arbeta på Basalt här!
 



  





**Din ansökan** 




 Ansök med ditt CV och beskriv kort vad du söker i din nästa roll. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
 



 På grund av sommar och semestertider kommer återkopplingen i denna process att dröja längre än vanligt, och vi planerar att påbörja urval och intervjuer efter semesterperioden.
 



 Vill du veta mer om rollen? Kontakta gärna Kajsa-Stina Åkerblom på 076 763 99 97 eller på
 
 kajsa-stina.akerblom@basalt.se
 
 .
 



  





**Basalt i korthet** 



* Grundat 2009, idag ca 150 medarbetare
* Kontor i Stockholm och Enköping
* En del av Omegapoint Group
* Ledande inom säkra IT-lösningar och systematiskt säkerhetsarbete
* Vision: att vara det självklara valet för ett robust och säkert samhälle



  





**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: Två seniora profiler till vår Software Factory-satsning i Stockholm
description:
*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*
 Vi söker nu två seniora profiler till vårt team som ansvarar för utvecklingen av vår Software Factory och DevSecOps-plattform. Vi står mitt i en strategisk moderniseringsresa där vi etablerar framtidens utvecklarmiljö med fokus på Platform Engineering, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, automation och säkerhetsintegrering från start. Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill arbeta nära tekniken, påverka arkitektur och strategiska vägval samt vara med och skapa plattformsförmågor som används av många utvecklingsteam.
   

  

 Du kommer in i ett skede där mycket fortfarande formas, vilket ger stort inflytande på såväl tekniska lösningar som arbetssätt och långsiktig målbild. Du är van att arbeta i komplexa miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet, stabilitet och långsiktig förvaltning, samtidigt som du identifierar möjligheter till automation, standardisering och kontinuerlig förbättring.
   

  

 Vi söker
 **två olika kompetensprofiler** 
 , men oavsett vilken roll som passar dig bäst blir du en del av samma team och samma förändringsresa mot en modern, skalbar och verksamhetskritisk utvecklingsplattform.
   

  

**Profil 1: Platform Engineer / DevSecOps Operations**
 Din roll
   

  

 Som Platform Engineer/DevSecOps blir du en nyckelperson i arbetet med att utveckla, automatisera och förvalta vår Software Factory. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, drift, säkerhetsfunktioner och produktägare för att skapa en stabil, säker och effektiv plattform som stödjer hela utvecklingslivscykeln. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla vår Software Factory och DevSecOps-plattform
* Driva automatisering av bygg-, test- och releaseprocesser
* Förvalta och utveckla Kubernetes-, Git- och CI/CD-plattformar
* Etablera och vidareutveckla GitOps- och Platform Engineering-arbetssätt
* Utveckla självbetjäningsfunktioner som ökar utvecklingsteamens produktivitet och självständighet
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet, prestanda och driftbarhet i plattformstjänsterna
* Arbeta med observability, monitorering, incidenthantering och operativ uppföljning
* Genomföra migreringar, moderniseringar och konsolidering av verktyg och plattformar
* Bidra till att plattformen utvecklas från pilot till fullskalig produktionsmiljö


 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet inom Platform Engineering, DevOps, Operations eller liknande områden och som trivs med att kombinera utveckling, automation och driftansvar. Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att bygga, utveckla och förvalta utvecklingsplattformar i större organisationer
* Gedigen erfarenhet av Kubernetes-baserade plattformar i produktion
* Erfarenhet av GitLab, Jenkins eller motsvarande CI/CD-lösningar
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code och automation
* God förståelse för DevSecOps, säkerhetsintegration och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* Erfarenhet av verksamhetskritiska plattformar med höga krav på stabilitet och tillgänglighet
* Förmåga att samarbeta över flera team och driva tekniska initiativ från idé till införande


 Meriterande är erfarenhet av GitOps, Terraform, ArgoCD, Artifactory, SonarQube, on-premises-miljöer, air-gapped miljöer eller säkerhetsklassad verksamhet.
   

  

**Profil 2: Software Factory & DevSecOps Solution Architect**
 Din roll
   

  

 Som Software Factory & DevSecOps Solution Architect ansvarar du för den långsiktiga målbilden och arkitekturen för vår utvecklingsplattform. Du kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med praktisk erfarenhet och är drivande i arbetet med att designa, transformera, implementera och vidareutveckla vår Software Factory. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Definiera målarkitektur och teknisk roadmap för utvecklingsplattformen
* Designa plattformslösningar för CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes och säkerhetsintegration
* Säkerställa att lösningar är skalbara, säkra, driftbara och långsiktigt förvaltningsbara
* Driva migreringar, moderniseringar och konsolidering av utvecklingsverktyg och plattformar
* Definiera integrationsarkitektur mellan utvecklingsverktyg, infrastruktur och identitetsplattformar
* Etablera plattformen som en intern produkt med självbetjäning, standardiserade arbetssätt och kontinuerlig förbättring
* Samarbeta med plattformsingenjörer, säkerhetsspecialister och verksamhetsrepresentanter
* Ta initiativ från koncept och pilotstadium till etablerad enterprise-drift


 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet som lösningsarkitekt, plattformsarkitekt eller motsvarande, och som har varit med och designat samt implementerat utvecklingsplattformar i större organisationer. Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av lösnings- eller plattformsarkitektur inom moderna utvecklingsplattformar
* Djup förståelse för Kubernetes, Platform Engineering och CI/CD-arkitektur
* Erfarenhet av DevSecOps, automatisering och säkerhetsintegration
* Erfarenhet av Git-baserade utvecklingsplattformar såsom GitLab eller Bitbucket
* Förmåga att balansera verksamhetskrav med tekniska vägval och långsiktig förvaltning
* Erfarenhet av transformation, modernisering eller migrering av utvecklingsmiljöer
* Ett tydligt operations- och förvaltningsperspektiv samt förståelse för vad som krävs för att skapa robusta plattformstjänster


 Meriterande är erfarenhet av GitLab-implementationer, Atlassian-migreringar, Platform Engineering-initiativ, säkerhetsklassade miljöer, regulatoriskt styrda verksamheter eller on-premises- och air-gapped miljöer.
   

  

*Befattningarna kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här
   

  

*Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.*

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for a curious and motivated platform engineer at the beginning of their career, with an interest in cloud infrastructure, observability and AI.
   

  

 You have a good technical foundation, strong drive and the potential to grow quickly, and enjoy understanding how things work. You are not expected to have experience in all the areas below. You will work alongside experienced engineers and with teams across research, development, and operations. You enjoy helping others and making technology easier to use. As you gain experience, you will take on more responsibility for the platforms and infrastructure we build.
   

  

 We also place great importance on personal qualities. We look for people who share our core values: professionalism, humility, generosity and curiosity. For this role, we particularly value curiosity, initiative and a genuine interest in technology.
   

  

**Required**
* Programming skills in Python or similar
* Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude Code or Codex
* Interest in cloud infrastructure and AI


**Meriting (experience/familiarity With)**
* AWS or another cloud platform
* Kubernetes and infrastructure as code
* CI/CD, monitoring and observability
* LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic or AWS Bedrock
* RAG, embeddings, tool calling, MCP or agentic applications


 You are fluent in English and have the right to work in Sweden. The position is based at our office in central Stockholm.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Platform Engineer at Lynx, you will help develop and maintain the technology platforms that support our quantitative investment research, development and operations.
   

  

 The role is broad, spanning AWS, observability and AI, with a particular focus on our AI platform. We are building common infrastructure that enables teams to develop and run AI applications, from early experiments to production. This includes LLM access, agent runtimes, MCP servers, evaluations, guardrails and observability, as well as data infrastructure for AI use cases such as RAG and embeddings.
   

  

 You will also work with our AWS environment, including Kubernetes, IAM, infrastructure as code, networking and security as well as observability tools that help teams monitor and understand our systems in production.
   

  

 An important part of the role is working with and supporting other teams, helping them use the platforms and tools we provide, solve problems together and improve the platform based on what they need.
   

  

 You won't be expected to know all of this from day one. We are looking for someone who wants to learn, take on more responsibility over time and work across different parts of our technology stack.
   

  

 To apply, please submit your application
 **no later than 9 November.**
**About Us**
 Lynx Asset Management is a quantitative asset manager of around 100 people, based in Stockholm. We apply scientific methods to create systematic investment strategies aimed at providing our clients with high risk-adjusted returns and attractive portfolio characteristics. Innovation has been part of our DNA since we were founded in 1999.
   

  

 At Lynx, we have created a workplace where academic methods and a focus on results are supported by a friendly, collegial culture. The well-being of our employees is important to us, as they are the ones who make our success possible. Lynx actively strives to be an inclusive workplace, and we see diversity as a prerequisite for future success.
   

  

 When applying, we'd also like to hear briefly about a project you've built or worked on that you found interesting. It could be a personal project, something from your studies or something you've done at work. It doesn't need to be large or polished. We're simply curious about what you chose to build and why.
   

  

 Lynx Asset Management was founded in Stockholm in 1999. Our goal is to provide clients with high risk-adjusted returns using systematic investment strategies, developed through scientific methods utilizing data, analysis and technology.

title: Data Engineer
description:

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Product
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We're seeking exceptional senior engineers and technical leaders for our Product team to help build the future of AI software creation. You will work across our entire stack to build features that will empower the next generation of creators and builders.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 10+ years of experience designing, building, and shipping production products, with a track record operating at senior engineering levels.
* Deep experience across the full stack, or strong backend depth - fluent in modern frontend (React/TypeScript) and/or backend (Golang, Rust) development.
* Solid understanding of systems design, performance tradeoffs, and scalable architecture for products serving millions of users.
* Strong product sense and the ability to make well-reasoned technical decisions - knowing when to prioritise speed and when to invest in foundational work.
* You own systems end-to-end: architecture, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity at an organisational level, not just technically.


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence:** 
 Do all it takes to build a generational product - scaling the core Lovable experience for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

* Build and scale the systems that power Lovable products, ensuring they're fast, reliable, and ready to support millions of users.
* Implement and maintain features across the stack - frontend, backend, and infrastructure - owning them from architecture through to production.
* Design, implement, and maintain backend services, APIs, and infrastructure components built for scale.
* Collaborate closely with ML, design, and product teams to translate capabilities into intuitive, mind-blowing user experiences.
* Drive the full development lifecycle, from technical planning to production launch and post-release iteration.
* Contribute to shaping our technical direction, engineering culture, and product strategy.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Engineering Manager – Tech Trading FX | SEB, Solna
description:
SEB is more than just a bank with a technology function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fueled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating for a sustainable society and building the tech arena of the future, a welcoming space for everyone.
   

  

 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join Tech Trading FX/MM and help drive our accelerated FX agenda. Our department is part of Technology Trading and consists of around 60 professionals delivering development and maintenance for FX trading. We operate in a fast-paced environment where time-to-market, stability, and quality are critical to business success.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team with approximately 12-16 employees within Tech Trading FX, combining leadership, technology, business understanding, and helping the team reach their full potential.
   

  

**You will:**
* Drive the technical agenda, roadmap and debt in close collaboration with the Tech Lead and Product Owner
* Coach and develop engineers, strengthening both technical excellence and team performance
* Work closely with business stakeholders to ensure alignment between solutions and client needs
* A key part of the role is to actively drive the adoption of modern technologies including cloud-native solutions, automation, and AI.


**You are expected to:**
* Identify opportunities where modern technologies create business value
* Encourage experimentation, curiosity and learning in the team
* Lead the evolution of ways of working, tools, and engineering practices


 You report to the Department Manager and are an active member of the management team.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are an experienced leader with a strong technical background, ideally having worked as an Engineering Manager with direct reports or in a similar leadership position for several years.
   

  

**You combine:**
* A hands-on understanding of modern software development
* Leadership experience with a focus on coaching and empowerment
* A strong interest in financial markets (FX knowledge is a merit)
* You are curious, forward leaning, and comfortable operating in a changing environment. More importantly, you actively drive change.


**We believe you:**
* Have a strong interest in modern technologies, agentic engineering, and AI.
* Inspire your team to explore, experiment, and adopt new ways of working
* See continuous learning and innovation as a natural part of building a high-performing team
* Are fluent in English and have strong communication skills. Being comfortable in speaking Swedish is a plus.


**As a leader, you:**
* Build trust and strong relationships with stakeholders
* Take accountability and drive initiatives forward
* Create an environment where people grow, thrive, contribute, and perform at their best


**Why this role matters**
 This is not a traditional management role. You will play a key role in shaping how modern engineering, AI, and automation are applied within FX both at team level and across the department. If you are motivated by combining leadership, technology, and transformation, this is an opportunity to make a real impact.
   

  

**As part of the application, you must explicitly describe:**
* Your experience in driving AI adoption and modern engineering practices to create business value
* Your role in leading or contributing to technology transformation and evolving ways of working
* Your ability to build a culture of experimentation, learning, and innovation within teams


 This is a prerequisite for the application being processed.
   

  

**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-08-25. If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Linn Odén at linn.oden@seb.se, note that we will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

title: Data center Engineer
description:
About the role We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably. You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability. Key responsibilities Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.
  
  

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling. Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution. Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management. Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.
  
  

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities. Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation. Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security. Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.
  
  

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes. Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required. Required qualifications Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role. Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.
  
  

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments. Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM. Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics. Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.
  
  

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors. Professional working proficiency in English. Preferred qualifications Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.
  
  

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools. Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible. Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure. Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

title: Hybrid Cloud Technician
description:
We are looking for a **Hybrid Cloud Technician** to join us at Telia Cygate.

  

  

Would you like to support and operate Cloud and Hybrid IT solutions in a collaborative environment that values continuous learning and diverse perspectives? Whether you bring extensive experience or are ready to take the next step in your career, this could be the opportunity for you.

  

  

My name is Daniel Jastér, and I lead the Hybrid IT & Cloud team at Telia Cygate. We are looking for a new colleague to join us as a **Hybrid Cloud Technician** . In this role, you will apply your expertise, develop alongside experienced colleagues, and contribute to shaping the future of digital infrastructure.

  

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

As a Hybrid Cloud Technician, you will help our customers maintain stable, secure, and reliable IT environments. Your responsibilities will include resolving incidents and service requests, performing maintenance and development activities, and working with specialist and support teams to address more complex issues. The role covers configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting, with a particular focus on Cloud and Hybrid IT.

  

  

You will not only work with today’s technology but also help shape the solutions of tomorrow. As part of our AI initiative, you will have the opportunity to explore emerging solutions, strengthen your expertise, and contribute ideas on how AI can create value for both customers and employees.

  

  

You are not expected to know everything from day one. You will be supported by experienced colleagues and given opportunities to continuously develop your skills.


Your responsibilities may include:

  

  

* **Microsoft 365 environments** : Maintenance, monitoring, security configuration, administration, and troubleshooting.
* **Windows Servers and Active Directory Domain Services** : Server configuration, Group Policies, domain controller management, and Certificate Services (PKI) administration.
* **Microsoft Defender and security solutions** : Administration, monitoring, and configuration of Microsoft Defender and Advanced Threat Protection.
* **VMware platforms** : Management, monitoring, and troubleshooting of virtual environments. Snapshots, backups, and restoration of virtual machines.
* **Linux, Kubernetes, and containers** : Management, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* **Veeam backup management** : Configuration, monitoring, scheduling, and troubleshooting.
* **Troubleshooting through log analysis** : Analysis of server and client logs.
* **Collaboration** : Supporting the Service Desk and other support teams with technical challenges and incidents.
  

  

**What will help you thrive in this role:**

  

You are motivated by solving problems, building trust, and helping customers overcome technical challenges. You collaborate effectively, share knowledge openly, and value constructive feedback. We place equal importance on curiosity, a structured approach, and a willingness to develop as we do on having all the answers from the outset.

  

  

* You have relevant IT experience gained through employment, education, or another setting in which you have developed equivalent expertise.
* Experience in several of the following areas is considered an advantage: Windows Server, Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Defender, Active Directory Domain Services, Linux, container platforms, Kubernetes, and Backup & Restore.
* General understanding of IT infrastructure, operating systems, networking, and end-user environments is considered an advantage.
* Excellent communication skills, with fluency in **Swedish (native or near-native)** and **good English.** Due to customer requirements, Swedish citizenship is required.
  

  

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification. If the role interests you and you believe you can make a valuable contribution, we would be pleased to hear from you.

  

  

**Why Telia Cygate?**  



  

At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun! As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile. Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.

  

  

Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.

  

  

Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!

  

  

**Telia Cygate is proud to be certificated as Great Place to Work!**  



  

With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.

  

  

**What we offer**  



  

When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.

  

  

**Interested? Apply!**

  

We look forward to receiving your application by **2026-11-01.** Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

  

  

**Location** : **Solna or Gothenburg** . This position offers a hybrid working arrangement.

  

  

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our **Talent Acquisition Partner.**  

Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

  

  

Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Daniel Jastér at daniel.jaster@cygate.se.

  

  

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.

  

  

**Equal opportunities**

  

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

  

  

**Welcome to Telia Cygate – Home of Experts**

* Experience of designing scalable, secure and maintainable software solutions.

title: GreenOps Cloud Efficiency Engineer
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a GreenOps Cloud Efficiency Engineer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve.


The partner is strengthening its capability in cloud efficiency that balances cost, performance and carbon impact. You will take responsibility for work that connects FinOps, workload profiling and rightsizing, while ensuring that carbon metrics and automation receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design.

### **How you will work**


The work combines planned platform development with investigation of real production behaviour. You will collaborate with application teams, security and operations, using their feedback to decide what should become a shared service, an automated control or clear documentation. Ownership continues after the first release.


This role calls for solid delivery experience and the appetite to take broader ownership. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for cloud efficiency that balances cost, performance and carbon impact.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for FinOps and workload profiling.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around rightsizing.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting carbon metrics.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve automation.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering cloud efficiency that balances cost, performance and carbon impact in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of FinOps and workload profiling.
* Practical experience applying rightsizing and carbon metrics.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving automation.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from large cloud estates or sustainability-led businesses.
* Exposure to executive reporting in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of cloud efficiency that balances cost, performance and carbon impact is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on cloud efficiency that balances cost, performance and carbon impact gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

title: Software Engineer III
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, PayPal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.  

  

  

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.  

  

  

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!  

  

  

**The Role**  

  

  

Our Onboarding team owns how new customers sign up to Sinch and get verified (KYC). It is the very first experience every customer has with us, so it needs to be fast, simple, and secure.  

  

  

As a Backend Software Engineer III, you will build and run the services behind these sign-up and verification flows. You will join a small Stockholm-based team alongside a Senior full-stack Tech Lead and a full-stack engineer, as we grow a permanent team that takes full ownership of the product. You will work closely with the Tech Lead, Product, and cross-functional teams. This is a hybrid role, working from our Stockholm office.  

  

  

**What You Will Do**  



Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs in Node.js and TypeScript.  

* 
Design and work with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).  
* 
Develop and deploy microservices on Kubernetes, using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.  
* 
Contribute to the distributed systems that power customer sign-up and verification.  
* 
Write clean, tested, maintainable code using sound design patterns.  
* 
Take part in code reviews and pull requests, and help raise code quality across the team.  
* 
Own the features you build from design through to production.  
* 
* Follow a build-ship-run approach.

**What We Are Looking For**  



3–4+ years of backend development experience.  

* 
Experience with Node.js (TypeScript is a plus).  
* 
Experience building REST APIs.  
* 
Good knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).  
* 
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes.  
* 
Experience working with distributed systems and microservices.  
* 
Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.  
* 
Comfortable with Git, code reviews, and pull requests.  
* 
Good understanding of clean code and basic design patterns.  
* 
Ability to work independently on most tasks.  
* 
Clear communication in English, written and spoken.  
* 
* Willingness to work hybrid from our Stockholm office.

**Nice to have**  



Working experience with Java (Spring or Spring Boot).  

* 
Event-driven development experience with RabbitMQ or Kafka.  
* 
* Experience with a cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

**OUR HIRING PROCESS**  

  

  

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.  

  

  

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!  

  

  

The salary range for this role is SEK 50,500 – 75,500 per month depending on experience.

title: Field Services Engineer
description:
**About Cognizant**  

Cognizant is a leading global technology and professional services company specializing in digital transformation and IT infrastructure services. We partner with enterprise clients worldwide to deliver seamless IT operations and exceptional end-user experiences. Our IT Infrastructure & Field Services teams are dedicated to providing hands-on technical support that keeps critical business environments running smoothly.

**The Role**  

Are you a hands-on technical professional who thrives in dynamic field environments? Join our IT Infrastructure & Field Services team as a Field Service Engineer, where you’ll deliver critical onsite technical support and ensure seamless IT operations across client locations throughout **Stockholm, Sweden**. You’ll work collaboratively with the Service Desk, third-party vendors, and client organizations to keep end-user environments running optimally.

**What You Will Do**  

You’ll perform onsite troubleshooting and resolution of hardware and software incidents, including user devices, operating systems, peripherals, and network connectivity. You’ll execute Moves, Adds, Changes & Disposals (MACDs), manage hardware installations, server reboots, and validate service functionality. Providing deskside support is key—you’ll assist with device provisioning, driver issues, hardware diagnostics, OS support, and software troubleshooting (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Cloud). You’ll also support audio-visual and video conferencing environments, coordinate with vendors, and manage AV equipment projects.  

Additionally, you’ll configure BIOS, hardware and OS settings, deploy software patches and hardware upgrades, decommission equipment, support employee onboarding, and ensure proper documentation of all service requests.

**What You Need**  

You bring 3+ years of proven experience in Field Service Engineering, Deskside Support, or similar hands-on IT support roles. You have strong knowledge of end-user device hardware, Windows operating systems, and enterprise applications like Microsoft Office 365 and Adobe Creative Cloud. Experience with device configuration (BIOS, OS deployment, VPN, encryption), ITIL-based service management, and ticketing systems is essential. Excellent communication and customer-facing skills—supporting both technical and non-technical users—are crucial.

**What Stands You Out**  

Experience supporting AV/VC environments, video conferencing suites, and telepresence systems is highly valued. Knowledge of network troubleshooting, VIP user support, asset management, and device decommissioning processes strengthens your candidacy. ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent is a plus.

**Why Join Us?**  

This onsite role offers the opportunity to make direct impact on client success every day. You’ll work in a collaborative environment with access to cutting-edge technologies and comprehensive support from a global technology leader. Cognizant prioritizes work-life balance through flexible arrangements and wellbeing programs, while offering competitive compensation and career development opportunities.

I rollen ansvarar du för att inom ditt affärsområde analyser och följa upp kreditrisker, identifiera trender och utveckla datadrivna lösningar som stärker våra kreditbeslut. Hos oss handlar kreditrisk inte om att minimera risk till varje pris. Det handlar om att förstå och balansera risk, försäljning och kundupplevelse för att hitta rätt nivå av kalkylerad risk, en risk som kan skapa möjligheter, driva försäljning och bidra till lönsam tillväxt. Du behöver därför kunna lyfta blicken från analysen och ställa frågan: Vad betyder det här för affären och vad kan vi göra annorlunda utifrån det?

title: Red Team Security Consultant
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Red Team Security Consultant on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve.


The partner is strengthening its capability in adversary simulation against modern applications and infrastructure. You will take responsibility for work that connects red teaming, cloud attack paths and social engineering controls, while ensuring that reporting and purple teaming receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design.

### **How you will work**


You will work directly with the people who design, operate and depend on the systems being protected. Recommendations must identify the threat, the affected asset and a realistic implementation path. The partner values careful evidence, proportionate controls and clear escalation when risk cannot be removed immediately.


This role calls for solid delivery experience and the appetite to take broader ownership. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for adversary simulation against modern applications and infrastructure.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for red teaming and cloud attack paths.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around social engineering controls.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting reporting.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve purple teaming.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering adversary simulation against modern applications and infrastructure in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of red teaming and cloud attack paths.
* Practical experience applying social engineering controls and reporting.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving purple teaming.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from complex enterprise or digital product environments.
* Exposure to remediation validation in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of adversary simulation against modern applications and infrastructure is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on adversary simulation against modern applications and infrastructure gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

description:
**AI, ML and LLM Platform Engineer**

  

**Role overview**


We are looking for AI and machine-learning engineers who can develop, train and deploy production-oriented models and ML services. Assignments may involve LLM applications, engineering automation, perception, sensor data, data pipelines or other industrial use cases.


This profile is intended for genuine ML engineering experience, not primarily BI, reporting or dashboard development.

  



**Responsibilities**


You may be responsible for:


* Building and maintaining machine-learning pipelines from data preparation through deployment.
* Training, evaluating and improving machine-learning models.
* Developing Python-based data and software components.
* Integrating or fine-tuning large language models for practical applications.
* Deploying ML services using containers, cloud platforms or orchestration tools.
* Monitoring model performance and improving production reliability.
* Collaborating with engineers, data scientists and domain specialists.
* Contributing to MLOps, experiment tracking, model versioning and CI/CD.

**Required experience**


* Strong professional Python development experience.
* Hands-on experience building or training models with PyTorch, TensorFlow or a comparable framework.
* Experience with data preparation, model training, evaluation and deployment.
* Experience developing software systems rather than only notebooks or ad hoc scripts.
* Understanding of production considerations such as testing, versioning, monitoring and deployment.
* Strong English communication skills.

**Preferred experience**


* LLM integration, RAG, prompt engineering or model fine-tuning.
* Kubernetes, Docker or cloud ML platforms.
* MLOps and automated ML pipelines.
* Computer vision, object detection, sensor data or time-series modelling.
* Automotive, industrial or engineering-domain experience.
* Experience with annotation processes and training-data quality.

**Who are we?**
---------------


**Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  

  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  

  

**Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  

  

**Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. title: Senior Industrial Designer
description:
**Senior Industrial Designer**

**Location: Malmö, Sweden**

  

At **Verisure**, design plays an important role in how millions of customers experience our products every day. We are now looking for a Senior Industrial Designer to join the Verisure Design Group and help shape the next generation of our products and connected security solutions.


Based at our Malmö **R&D centre**, you will report to the Global Design Director and the Industrial Design Team Lead and work as part of our Global Design Team, collaborating closely with colleagues across design, engineering, product and other functions. The role will also involve collaboration with external agencies, vendors and partners, primarily across Europe, with some European travel required.

 **The role**


As a Senior Industrial Designer, you will play a key role in creating world-class Industrial Design solutions across the Verisure product portfolio.


You will be responsible for the creation, development, refinement and documentation of innovative and compelling design solutions that support a cohesive and consistent experience across our future product offering.


Working closely with the Global Design Director, Industrial Design Team Lead and the wider Verisure Global Design Team, you will contribute throughout the full product development process – from early research and exploration through concept development, refinement, product development and final delivery.


You will work across both tactical product development programmes and more strategic and exploratory workstreams, helping us challenge existing thinking and identify new opportunities for our future products.

 **What you will do**


Your responsibilities will include:

* Play a key role in Industrial Design projects from initial concept through to market delivery, providing creative and technical design expertise to multidisciplinary project teams.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the technical, operational and commercial requirements of each project and identify innovative solutions within those constraints.
* Translate business requirements and user needs into tangible design concepts, balancing the perspectives of our end users, installers, sales teams and markets.
* Develop and refine concepts through sketching, 3D modelling, visualisation, prototyping and presentation.
* Work closely with engineering teams to translate Industrial Design concepts into tangible, manufacturable and market-ready products.
* Ensure deliverables are completed to a consistently high standard for internal design reviews, stakeholder discussions and leadership presentations.
* Build productive and collaborative relationships with internal functional partners as well as external agencies, suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Proactively raise the quality of both design thinking and execution, continuously exploring new ideas and approaches to solving stakeholder and user needs.
* Contribute to CMF – colour, material and finish – exploration, development and specification.
* Stay up to date with Industrial Design trends, tools, technologies and working practices to ensure we continue to apply industry best practice.

 **What we are looking for**


Required qualifications and experience


We are looking for an experienced Industrial Designer with a strong combination of creativity, technical understanding and experience bringing physical products to market.

 **You will ideally bring:**

* A BA (Hons) degree or equivalent in Industrial Design.
* 8+ years of relevant Industrial Design experience, ideally within consumer electronics, telecommunications, connected products or a similar product-led industry.
* Strong 3D modelling skills, using tools such as Autodesk Alias or Rhino.
* Strong rendering and visualisation skills, using tools such as KeyShot or Cinema 4D.
* Advanced experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator.
* A comprehensive understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and product development.
* A proven track record of contributing to successful products launched across multiple international markets.
* Experience with CMF – colour, material and finish – exploration and specification.
* Strong graphic design and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate concepts clearly and visually.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.

 **About you**


You are passionate about Industrial Design and motivated by creating products that combine a great user experience with exceptional design quality.


You are proactive, curious and comfortable bringing new ideas into multidisciplinary teams. You enjoy working collaboratively while also taking ownership of your work and pushing projects forward.

  

You will also:

* Build strong and collaborative relationships with stakeholders and colleagues within a global matrix organisation.
* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving international environment with multiple teams, markets and perspectives.
* Listen, observe and seek to understand real user needs, translating those insights into meaningful design solutions.
* Be a creative problem solver who continuously looks for opportunities to improve products, processes and ways of working.
* Be able to clearly articulate the thinking behind your concepts through compelling storytelling, connecting strong design rationale with creative output.
* Bring an inclusive and collaborative approach and a strong understanding of design thinking practices and methodologies.
* Have an interest in current and emerging smart home, connected home and home security technologies, as well as the customer needs and use cases behind them.

 **Your application**


Please include:

* Your CV.
* A concise visual portfolio demonstrating relevant Industrial Design work (PDF preferred).
* A cover letter or personal statement, including your salary expectations.

 **Strong fit with our Company DNA**


Our Company DNA defines how we work together and how we continue building Verisure:

**Passionate in Everything We Do**  

Our people have a sense of energy that is unmistakable – one that drives us to delight our customers and focus on creating impact quickly.

**Committed to Making a Difference**  

When we say we will do something, we deliver with excellence. We are accountable, focused and operate with discipline.

**Always Innovating**  

We believe innovation can be big or small. It is a continuous state of mind that inspires us to think differently and always make things better.

**Winning as a Team**  

Our people know that by leveraging one another's strengths, investing in and developing our team's capabilities, and collaborating well, we will win.

**With Trust & Responsibility**  

Operating with integrity is core to our success. We are humble and honest, value deep mastery and expertise, and do the right thing – always.

 **Apply today!**


If you are excited about creating thoughtful, beautifully designed products that form part of a global connected security ecosystem, we would love to hear from you.


Verisure Innovation is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international organisation with colleagues and offices across multiple countries and are committed to creating an inclusive working environment.


If you have questions regarding the position, please reach out to our Group TA Specialist, Lucas Stenberg, at lucas.stenberg@verisure.com.

 **About Verisure**


Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to approximately 6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, supported by a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.


For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million. This performance builds on the company's long-term track record of resilient growth and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.


Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.


Since 8 October 2025, Verisure has been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, the listing represented the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in more than 25 years.

title: Senior Container Security Engineer
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Senior Container Security Engineer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve.


The partner is strengthening its capability in security controls embedded in container platforms and delivery pipelines. You will take responsibility for work that connects Kubernetes security, admission control and image signing, while ensuring that runtime defence and CI security receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate.


The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design.

### **How you will work**


You will work directly with the people who design, operate and depend on the systems being protected. Recommendations must identify the threat, the affected asset and a realistic implementation path. The partner values careful evidence, proportionate controls and clear escalation when risk cannot be removed immediately.


This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**

* Own the practical direction for security controls embedded in container platforms and delivery pipelines.
* Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for Kubernetes security and admission control.
* Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around image signing.
* Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting runtime defence.
* Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve CI security.
* Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team.

### **What you will bring**

* Relevant experience delivering security controls embedded in container platforms and delivery pipelines in a demanding environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes security and admission control.
* Practical experience applying image signing and runtime defence.
* Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving CI security.
* Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
* Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Experience from cloud-native product organisations.
* Exposure to cloud IAM in a cross-functional environment.
* Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of security controls embedded in container platforms and delivery pipelines is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on security controls embedded in container platforms and delivery pipelines gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

### **The recruitment conversation**


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

title: ITSM Process and Tool Manager —
description:
**Job description**
-------------------


As ITSM Process and Tool manager in Arelion, you will be accountable for effective ITSM processes and an ITSM platform that enable consistent incident, problem, change, and request management. The role aligns process governance, tool configuration, integrations, access, reporting, and continual improvement to reliable service delivery and evolving business needs.
  

Arelion operates a complex IT environment consisting of a DC/IaaS hybrid running a variety of applications, both COTS and in-house developed. We depend on highly skilled people in Arelion and within our support partners to be able to follow efficient processes every day to keep lights. They need the best possible tooling to join forces to solve incidents, investigate complex problems, and handle planned changes. This is where the ITSM Process and Tool manager can make a big difference. You will take over a working foundation, govern it over time, and improve to facilitate even better collaboration and increase efficiency.
**Skills & requirements**
-------------------------


* At least five years of relevant IT service, operations, support, or ITSM experience in a managed-service environment
* Strong practical knowledge of ITIL processes and experience delivering service quality within an ITIL framework
* Experience administering and configuring ITSM platforms, including workflows, access roles, integrations, dashboards, and reports
* Understanding of IT infrastructure, operating systems, AWS, data centre technologies, VMware, CMDB, monitoring, and asset-management concepts
* Strong written and spoken English, stakeholder communication, vendor coordination, planning, organisation, and structured problem-solving
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with ITIL Foundation certification beneficial
**Job responsibilities**
------------------------


* Govern and improve Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management processes within the ITIL framework
* Maintain and configure the ITSM platform to support approved service-management processes and workflows
* Align forms, workflows, dashboards, and reports with organisational and stakeholder needs
* Manage platform roles, permissions, and access controls for secure and appropriate use
* Coordinate integration of the ITSM platform with monitoring, CMDB, asset-management, event/alarm sources, and other relevant systems
* Monitor process and tool performance, service-level compliance, and data quality, and address identified issues
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, engineering, support, service-delivery, and supplier stakeholders
* Maintain clear process, configuration, and operating documentation
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardise, and optimise IT service management
**Job benefits**
----------------


* Annual performance based bonus
* ATK (work time shortening). 4.69 hours added to a time bank every month. Can be used to take part of day or full day off.
* Holiday Allowance: 30 days
* Wellness contribution. You can be reimbursed for up to 3 000 SEK a calendar year for massage and exercise-related expenses.
* Pension plan ITP1. More information available online at collectum.se
  

  

Please note that certain positions are subject to background screening.


  
**Why work at Arelion?**
------------------------


##### **Equal Opportunity Employer**


We celebrate diversity and respect everyone’s uniqueness, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or personality.

  

##### **Diverse Workplace**


We foster a richer and more inclusive environment that encourages a safe base, from which to explore, challenge and grow.

  

##### **Health & Wellbeing**


We strive for a healthier and happier workplace by providing support services such as our Employee Assistance Program.

  

  

##### **Work-life balance approach**


We empower our people to better balance their personal and professional lives, improving overall wellbeing and job satisfaction.

  

##### **Hybrid Workspace**


We offer a hybrid workplace approach, providing greater choice to our employees about where, when, and how they work.


  
### **About us****—**


Arelion is a privately owned global connectivity provider supporting enterprises, digital platforms and service providers around the world. Our network has been built and refined over more than 30 years, and our backbone now spans 80,000+ km across Europe, North America and Asia, connecting customers in 129 countries. Built with a consistent architecture and direct interconnection to major clouds, data centers and exchange points, it supports stable performance and predictable outcomes across a wide range of use cases. Combined with experienced teams, clear accountability and responsive support, we help customers operate with confidence and scale without disruption.

description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI, automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible, and future-proof solutions for our customers and society.



Are you a senior architect with strong trading-domain expertise who can turn complex stakeholder needs into clear direction and execution? We are looking for a Domain Architect to shape the technology direction for Tech Trading and enable secure, resilient and scalable transformation at SEB.



**About the role**



Tech Trading provides business-critical technology across the trading lifecycle, including pricing, execution, risk, position management, market data and regulatory requirements.



As Domain Architect, you will continuously develop and implement the Tech Trading target architecture, aligned with SEB’s enterprise architecture, principles and technical standards. With the customer as the primary stakeholder, you will balance business, regulatory and technology priorities, consolidate different interests in an actionable direction and stay ahead of relevant market and technology trends.



You will work closely with stakeholders across business and technology, from senior executives and regulators to engineering teams, partners and suppliers. You will be accountable for solution architecture in the domain, be part of the Tech Trading Leadership Team and drive strategic topics. You will also lead, empower, and develop a team of Solution Architects with full line-management responsibility.



**Your key responsibilities will include:**



* Define, drive and continuously improve the Tech Trading target architecture and roadmap, aligned with enterprise architecture and SEB principles.
* Translate customer, business, regulatory and technology priorities into clear decisions across products, platforms and solution architecture.
* Drive modernization, integration and simplification while ensuring security, resilience and operational continuity.
* Lead architecture governance and portfolio-level dialogue, steer significant initiatives and help teams apply the architecture in delivery.
* Contribute proactively to SEB’s architecture community and the further development of enterprise architecture.
**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**



* Extensive experience from architecture work in complex, business-critical environments, combined with the ability to decide, execute and drive change.
* Deep trading-domain knowledge and practical experience within FX, Fixed Income, Commodities and Equities.
* Proven ability to lead technology transformation and modernize legacy landscapes without compromising resilience.
* Broad architecture competence across integration, data, cloud, cybersecurity and infrastructure.
* A strategic, customer-focused and empowering leadership style
* Strong communication skills and fluent English, with the ability to align stakeholders from senior management to engineering teams.
**Do you want to be part of SEB?**



It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-10-26. If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Linn Odén at linn.oden@seb.se, note that we will not process applications via email.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime.
